author: Solange Guimarães
title: STF pode ser enfraquecido por interesses políticos se Flávio for eleito, avaliam juristas
content:
O Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF) está longe de ser perfeito na análise de três juristas especialistas em direito constitucional, direitos humanos e reforma do Estado ouvidos pela

Agência Pública

. As suas imperfeições e a recente crise institucional que a mais alta instância do poder judiciário no Brasil e “guardiã da Constituição Federal” está passando, não devem ser, entretanto, usadas como justificativa do jogo político que visa aumentar a impunidade. E é consenso entre os três, que o risco existe. 


“O desgaste do STF pode ser usado politicamente não apenas para corrigir excessos da Corte, o que é legítimo, mas para reduzir sua capacidade de funcionar como limite ao poder político”, afirma Amarílis Costa, doutora em Direitos Humanos e diretora-executiva da Rede Liberdade, que atua em casos de violação de direitos e liberdades individuais.

“Uma coisa é democratizar, tornar mais transparente e limitar excessos do STF. Outra é submeter a Corte à maioria parlamentar de ocasião”

, argumenta.


Costa destaca a importância da Corte e de sua estabilidade justamente para aqueles que não estão nas rodas do poder. “Isso importa especialmente em direitos humanos, porque minorias e grupos historicamente vulnerabilizados dependem de uma jurisdição constitucional capaz de conter maiorias quando seus direitos estão em risco”, acrescenta.


Advogada Amarillis Costa vê tentativa de limitar ações do STF contra políticos no poder


O professor de direito na PUC-SP e ex-secretário Nacional de Reforma do Judiciário no governo Dilma Rousseff, Flávio Crocce Caetano, concorda com a advogada. Ele acrescenta que “ a conjuntura política se tornaria muito favorável a medidas autoritárias de um eventual governo Bolsonaro, com diminuição do papel do STF, possível

impeachment

 de ministro, além da redução do prazo de mandatos atuais, aumento do número de cadeiras para obtenção de imediata maioria e parceria perene com o Legislativo”. 


Para Caetano, “experiências autocráticas”

em outros países são exemplos de concentração de poder nas mãos do Executivo, com ajuda do Legislativo, para o “apequenamento do Judiciário”. 


O também professor Rubens Beçak, livre-docente em Teoria Geral do Estado na USP, acompanha seus pares sobre o risco de

Flávio Bolsonaro

, se eleito presidente, “tentar minar o papel do Supremo, mesmo enfrentando “reações da opinião pública, da comunidade jurídica e provavelmente do próprio tribunal”. 


Ele ressalva que isso não significa que “discutir a redução do ativismo judicial, o excesso de decisões monocráticas e até os critérios de indicação dos ministros” não seja legítimo. “Essas mudanças podem contribuir para um Supremo melhor”, avalia Beçak que não descarta a possibilidade de se realizar uma Reforma do Judiciário. 


Reforma do Judiciário pode sanar excesso de decisões individuais


Flávio Caetano é professor na PUC-SP e foi secretário Nacional de Reforma do Judiciário durante a gestão de Dilma Rousseff


Já Flávio Caetano diz que “é necessária uma Reforma do Judiciário, que também atinja o Supremo.” Segundo o professor da PUC, estamos “diante de uma crise institucional, e de uma disfuncionalidade do STF”. Essa conjuntura “tem levado a posturas muito individuais dos ministros” e um acúmulo de decisões monocráticas, que faz o Plenário da Corte ficar diminuído. 


Amarílis Costa denomina o problema de individualização excessiva do poder, o que, segundo ela, “não significa eliminar decisões monocráticas”. “Elas são necessárias em situações urgentes. O problema surge quando uma decisão concebida como provisória produz, por longo período, efeitos equivalentes aos de uma decisão definitiva”, explica.


As decisões monocráticas foram alargadas nas práticas das últimas décadas do Supremo, e por isso deveriam ser “extremamente limitadas” na análise de Rubens Beçak.

“Não é desejável que um ministro tenha poder individual sobre questões tão importantes”

, afirma. “O correto é que a decisão individual, depois de tomada, seja prontamente submetida à Turma ou ao Plenário”, complementa. 


O comportamento do STF em período eleitoral


Rubens Beçak, professor na Faculdade de Direito da USP, considera correta postura de presidente do STF, Edson Fachin, sobre processo sobre caso Master


Além da concentração de poder, os ministros do STF são, comumente, criticados por decisões que podem influenciar a opinião pública e as intenções de voto em período eleitoral. Para os juristas entrevistados pela

author: Publicación Abierta
title: Los verdugos de medio mundo se disfrazan de jueces: nueva acusación inventada contra Maduro y Cilia Flores
content:
Una acusación más para tapar un crimen.


El imperio no se detiene. Tras secuestrar al presidente legítimo de Venezuela, Nicolás Maduro, y a la primera dama, Cilia Flores, en una operación terrorista del ejército de los EE. UU. en territorio venezolano que dejó al menos cien muertos, según el balance del Gobierno venezolano —civiles que dormían en sus casas, militares venezolanos y 32 miembros de las fuerzas cubanas—, ahora llega una nueva acusación. Según los documentos judiciales, ambos son acusados de conspiración para torturar a opositores políticos y, a Cilia Flores, además, se le imputa conspiración para cometer narcoterrorismo, un cargo que hasta ahora solo pesaba sobre el presidente.


Cuando el relato inicial hace aguas, se amplía el expediente. Es el viejo manual: primero se secuestra y después se busca el delito que lo justifique.


Quienes torturan no pueden dar lecciones.


Los mismos que torturan en Guantánamo, que torturaron en Irak y por medio mundo, tienen la desvergüenza de acusar de tortura al presidente Maduro y a su esposa. Los mismos que ampararon durante años la red de abusos a menores de la isla de Jeffrey Epstein, amigo en su día del presidente Donald Trump y muerto en una cárcel federal sin que se haya aclarado todo lo que había que aclarar, se erigen en defensores de los derechos humanos.


Los mismos que sostienen el genocidio en Palestina, los mismos que mantienen el brutal bloqueo genocida contra Cuba, son los que secuestran a un jefe de Estado y lo sientan en un banquillo en Nueva York.


Una vergüenza para toda la humanidad.


Maduro y Cilia Flores, de 63 y 69 años, permanecen secuestrados en Nueva York y su juicio está programado para el 1 de junio de 2027. Un presidente y su esposa, arrancados de su país por la fuerza, en abierta violación de la legalidad internacional, de la soberanía de los pueblos y de los derechos humanos más elementales.


Y frente a esto, el silencio. Un silencio cómplice y cobarde de gobiernos, de instituciones y de muchos que se dicen demócratas y progresistas, que permite este atropello sin pestañear. Si hoy se puede secuestrar a un presidente por orden de Washington, mañana se podrá hacer con cualquiera que no se arrodille.


La historia no perdona.


La historia no absolverá a los secuestradores y asesinos, ni a sus cómplices, ni a los traidores, ni a quienes miran para otro lado o callan por cobardía.


¡Até á vitoria sempre!


André Abeledo Fernández

author: Publicación Abierta
title: España. Maricarmen: la mataron los buitres y sus cómplices
content:
Maricarmen ha muerto. Tenía 87 años, había vivido más de 70 en la misma casa, en el madrileño barrio de Retiro, y la echaron de ella un 23 de septiembre. Desde ese día permaneció hospitalizada. No volvió a vivir en su hogar y ahora ya no volverá nunca.


Un crimen con nombre y apellidos.


Digámoslo sin rodeos, porque la hipocresía institucional ya tendrá tiempo de hablar de «tragedia» y «lamentable desenlace»: a Maricarmen no se la llevó el destino. La desahuciaron unos buitres carroñeros, de esos que ven en una casa una cifra y en una anciana un estorbo. Y lo hicieron con el amparo de políticos que son todavía peores, porque ellos, al menos, no disimulan que su negocio es la rapiña. Los otros fingen que no ven lo que sus leyes y sus votos hacen posible.


Una tortura evitable de principio a fin.


Se logró, por fin, un acuerdo para que pudiese volver a la que fue su vivienda durante más de siete décadas. Pero llegó tarde. Llegó cuando el proceso ya había hecho su trabajo: una tortura que enfermó y agotó a una mujer de 87 años. Una situación absolutamente evitable. Nadie necesitaba echar a Maricarmen a la calle. Alguien decidió que hacerlo era legal, rentable y aceptable. Esa es la verdadera obscenidad.


No olvidemos con quién están.


Que nadie se lave las manos. PP, VOX, Junts per Catalunya, Aliança Catalana y toda esa basura ultraderechista están del lado de los buitres, siempre lo han estado y siempre lo estarán. Votan contra la vivienda digna, defienden la propiedad de los fondos frente al derecho a un techo y luego se ponen la corbata de la compasión cuando el cadáver ya está frío. Son cómplices. No hay otra palabra.


Maricarmen es un símbolo, pero antes fue una persona.


Su desahucio levantó una ola de movilizaciones por el acceso a una vivienda digna, y eso honra a quienes salieron a la calle. Pero no convirtamos a Maricarmen solo en bandera. Fue una mujer con una vida entera entre esas paredes y se la robaron en el último tramo de ella. Que su muerte no se archive como un caso mediático más. Cada día hay Maricarmen sin cámaras, sin manifestaciones y sin acuerdos de última hora.


Organizarse es lo único que nos queda.


Ni la caridad ni los lamentos nos devolverán a Maricarmen. Lo único que frena a los buitres es la organización de la clase trabajadora, el sindicato de inquilinas, la plataforma de afectados, el vecino que se planta delante de la puerta. Ellos solo temen una cosa: que el pueblo se una y se niegue a mirar hacia otro lado.


Descansa en paz, Maricarmen. Y a los que te mataron, ni perdón ni olvido.


Até á vitoria sempre!


André Abeledo Fernández

author: David Swanson
title: Webinar: NATO and the Balkans
content:
Endangerment, Europe, NATO, Videos, Why End War, World

By No to War – No to NATO, October 9, 2026

This webinar examines the militarisation of the Balkans and the role of NATO. It considers both the historical aspects of the war against Serbia, which contravened international law, and the current challenges posed by widespread militarisation. Key topics include the current and future role of NATO, its member organisations and its partners. The webinar highlights the forces opposing militarisation and advocating for a peaceful Balkans.

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: Navi Pillay, South African Jurist, Wins Nobel Peace Prize in "Stinging Rebuke to Donald Trump"
content:
The 2026 Nobel Peace Prize has been awarded to Navanethem “Navi” Pillay, the South African jurist who led the United Nations commission of inquiry that concluded that Israel had committed genocide in Gaza. Pillay’s long career in international human rights law includes work as a defense attorney for anti-apartheid activists, president of the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda, a former judge at the International Criminal Court and the U.N.’s high commissioner for human rights from 2008 to 2014.


“Everybody in the human rights movement reveres Navi Pillay,” says war crimes prosecutor Reed Brody, who calls the award “a stinging rebuke to Donald Trump.” Brody, a member of the United Nations Group of Human Rights Experts on Nicaragua, also comments on the Trump administration’s decision to deport a Nicaraguan opposition activist, Jeffrey Jarquín, from the United States, where he was in the process of seeking asylum. Upon his return to Nicaragua, Jarquín was immediately imprisoned at the same facility in which he was once tortured.

author: Nehaa Bimal
title: Videographer assaulted while filming for Gjoa Haven clean energy initiative
content:
A videographer

was assaulted Monday in Gjoa Haven while filming for an energy-saving initiative, says Mayor Raymond Quqshuun Sr.


“The hamlet is taking the incident seriously while respecting the privacy of those involved,” Quqshuun said in an email to Nunatsiaq News on Thursday.


It’s unclear what exactly happened but the victim was uninjured, Quqshuun said. The incident was reported to the hamlet but not the RCMP.


The mayor did not say if the victim was visiting the community and declined to provide any further details.


In a Facebook post on Wednesday, the account for the hamlet’s mayor described the victim as a videographer involved in Gjoa Haven’s Winter Clean Energy Challenge, an initiative that encourages households to reduce energy use in the winter.


“Incidents like these are unusual,” Quqshuun said in his email, adding that the community is known to be “particularly warm and welcoming” to guests.


Run by the Kikitak Housing Association, Qulliq Energy Corp., the hamlet maintenance team and Yukon University’s Northern Energy Innovation program, the challenge provides participants with weather-stripping material, window film and energy-friendly shower heads.


The household with the largest energy reduction wins an electric side-by-side utility terrain vehicle, Quqshuun said.

author: Charlotte Reck
title: Police Spent £320k on Face ID Tech That Achieved Nothing
content:
British Transport Police (BTP) have spent more than £320k and almost 100 hours of officers’ time on a six-month trial of live facial recognition (LFR) technology in London’s railway stations – yielding just one incorrect face match and no arrests. 


The surveillance tech scans passersby and alerts authorities if it recognises someone on a watchlist. It is supposed to help catch people accused of crimes or who breach court orders.


But a freedom of information request

by Liberty Investigates

,

shared with the Guardian

 in September, revealed that after scanning more than half a million faces between February and July, the tech only sent one suspect alert, and that turned out to be a false positive. 


Despite this failure, Transport for London (TfL) has given permission for the technology to be expanded across London Underground stations too. 


TfL said the technology could make a vital contribution to tackling violence against the capital’s women and girls, whose travel experiences are too-often “shaped by experiences of sexual harassment and sexual offences”.


The UK’s former biometrics and surveillance camera commissioner, Fraser Sampson, told the Guardian that use of facial ID tech must be proportionate to the need. “Success for the police trying to catch people means people being caught. In that respect the trial doesn’t appear to have been very fruitful,” he said.


Sampson is a non-executive director of facial recognition company Facewatch. which specialises in the technology’s use in shops. Facewatch’s own technology has led to a number of people being

falsely accused of stealing

 by supermarkets. 


Sampson’s appointment at Facewatch after leaving his government job

was criticised

 as an “outrageous conflict of interest”. He said at the time that he “put in place specific measures” to avoid the risk of any conflicts, “however limited that potential might be”. 


Liberty Investigates found that more than half of police forces in England and Wales are using LFR. 


A recent report from parliament’s joint committee on human rights called for more robust laws to address the threat of AI to human rights, and called LFR as a “clear example of risk”.

author: David Swanson
title: Reactors on the Moon?
content:
By Karl Grossman,

CounterPunch

, October 9, 2026


The lead front page

story

 in the New York Times this week was headlined: “Superpowers Racing to Put Nuclear Reactors on Moon.” The nations involved: the U.S., China and Russia. And there was a subhead: “Experts Warn of Radioactive Risks From a Rocket Mishap or Lunar Meltdown.”


The reporter, Selam Gebrekidan, wrote: “Failures could cause a chain reaction with dire consequences. Falling reactor debris could scatter radioactive material….An explosion or a meltdown on the moon’s surface could risk turning entire regions into no-go zones.”


The extensive story quoted Edward Lyman, director of nuclear power safety at the Union of Concerned Scientists, saying: “There will always be a space race going on, and if you enter nuclear power into that mix, then it could take a potentially more dangerous turn.”


Nuclear power and weapons in space have been an unexpectedly extensive part of my journalistic journey. Because of having been deeply involved in reporting about the plans of the Long Island Lighting Company to construct seven to 11 nuclear power plants on Long Island, where I live, I became knowledgeable about atomic energy.


I wrote a book titled “Power Crazy” about this scheme to turn the island into what nuclear promoters termed then a “nuclear park.” I wrote many columns and did television reporting on it.


So, back in 1985, with that experience, I was struck by a piece in the U.S. Department of Energy’s publication, “Energy Insider,” saying that DOE and NASA were partners in the sending up in 1986 two space shuttles—one being the Challenger—with space probes onboard fueled by plutonium, considered the most toxic of all radioactive substances.


Once the shuttles achieved orbit, the probes would be released, the one Challenger carried to survey Jupiter. The plutonium would be in radioisotope thermoelectric generators (RTGs), not for propulsion but to provide electric power for instruments.


In “Energy Insider” there was notice that the government had looked into various sorts of accidents that might happen on the missions. So, I sent Freedom of Information Act requests to DOE, NASA, and the DOE national laboratories involved in these studies asking to learn what was determined.


As the months passed, I began to realize I had hit upon a hot potato. I was denied the information on the grounds it was “technical” which is not a legitimate FOIA exemption. I appealed and won. Finally, to my post office came a box of documents, including a government projection that the likelihood of a “catastrophic” shuttle accident was 1-in-100,00. Those were very high odds, so I didn’t do anything.


That was until January 28, 1986, when on my way to teach my Investigative Reporting class at the State University of New York at Old Westbury, I heard on the car radio that the Challenger had exploded on launch.


I stopped at an appliance store and saw that terrible image on TV and telephoned The Nation magazine to tell them that the next mission of the Challenger, in May, was to involve a nuclear system—and if the accident occurred then and plutonium released as dust, the disaster could have been a massive catastrophe.


The Nation asked me to write a front-page editorial, which I did. Other media picked up on it and I was pretty widely interviewed. A publisher called resulting in a book that he titled “The Wrong Stuff.” Meanwhile, NASA and DOE changed the odds of a catastrophic shuttle accident from 1-in-100,000 to 1-in 7 6.


And I began to “follow the money” as Bob Woodward’s source “Deep Throat” instructed in the film about the Watergate investigation.


I did, and found the then “Star Wars” program of President Reagan was predicated on orbiting battle platforms with onboard hypervelocity guns, particle beams and laser weapons and, also onboard, nuclear reactors and “super plutonium” systems providing the high energy they needed. The latter would be built by General Electric, manufacturer of the RTGs on the space probe that Challenger was to loft.


NASA’s use of nuclear power in space was being done in parallel with the plan for nuclear-powered weaponry in space.


This resulted in another book I authored, “Weapons in Space,” its foreword by Dr. Michio Kaku, and an hour-long TV documentary I wrote and presented, “Nukes in Space: The Nuclearization and Weaponization of the Heavens.” And there have been many articles on this and more TV programs during the ensuing four …

title: Women's delegation from North Kurdistan visits Rojava
content:
The women’s delegation from North Kurdistan visited the Martyr Xebat Dêrik Cemetery in the city of Dêrik together with the families of martyrs and laid carnations on the graves of the martyrs.


The delegation included Devrim Demir, co-mayor of Mardin Metropolitan Municipality, who was replaced by a state-appointed trustee, and co-spokesperson of the Local Governments Diplomacy Committee; Safiye Aladağ, co-mayor of Amed Yenişehir Municipality; Sevim Biçici, co-mayor of Silvan (Farqîn) Municipality; Belkize Beştaş Epözdemir, co-mayor of Tatvan Municipality; and Rûken Demir, a member of the Diplomacy Committee.


The delegation members drew attention to the sacrifices made by the martyrs and stated that they would continue to uphold their struggle. Following the cemetery visit, the delegation visited the Council of Martyrs’ Families in Dêrik.


Cooperation between local administrations discussed


Today, the women’s delegation met with Îlham Ehmed, co-chair of the Department of Foreign Relations of the Autonomous Administration of North and East Syria, and Cîhan Hesam, director of the Qamishlo Region.


Speaking after the meeting, the delegation said that the purpose of the visit was to share the experiences of local administrations, strengthen cooperation between institutions, and explore ways to contribute to joint initiatives.


The delegation emphasized the need to strengthen relations between institutions in North Kurdistan and Rojava, and expressed their expectation that border crossings would be opened to facilitate travel between the two regions.

author: Unknown
title: Key issues in integration with Damascus remain unresolved
content:
The integration process between the Damascus Interim Government and the Autonomous Administration in Syria has entered a new phase in the military sphere, while developments over the past month in particular have made uncertainties surrounding the political, social and cultural dimensions of the process more visible. Restrictions on Kurdish-language education and the protests against them, the killing of Hasakah (Hesekê) Brigade fighter Sîpan Hiznî, and people taking to the streets following the prison fire in Kobanê all occurred during the same period.


The new phase, which began with the announcement on 25 August that the Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) would cease to exist as an independent military structure, is progressing with the incorporation of its fighters into the Syrian army. Steps are being taken to integrate the Kobanê Brigade into an Aleppo-based structure and the forces in Hasakah into the institutions of the Interim Government.


However, progress in military integration has not resolved questions about the future of the education, security, cultural and local government institutions that Kurds have built over the past 14 years. Discussions are continuing over the extent to which these institutions will be preserved and what status they will have in the new Syria.


Continuous protests for Kurdish-language education


The most widespread social impact of the tensions has emerged in education. Under a decision taken by the Syrian Ministry of Education on 27 August, Kurdish was defined as a national language, while Kurdish-language classes were limited to three hours a week. History, geography, social studies and philosophy are allowed to be taught in Kurdish, while subjects such as mathematics and science are planned to be taught in Arabic.


The decision marked a significant departure from the education system established in North and East Syria since 2012. In Rojava, a system had been developed in which Kurdish was used as the language of instruction from kindergarten through university, with Kurdish-language textbooks and curricula prepared. Students who have studied in their mother tongue for years and their families have been protesting in the streets for days, stressing that the decision represents a new form of assimilation, that language is the cornerstone of identity and that Kurdish cannot be restricted to three hours of optional classes a week.


Parents say that their children’s right to receive a full education in their own language is a fundamental right and cannot be subject to negotiation. Students say they will boycott classes until the decision is withdrawn and Kurdish is recognized as an official language of education.


Yesterday the Baath regime, today HTS


Kurdish was also systematically banned from all areas of social life for decades under the Baath regime. The ban on Kurdish became systematic after the Baath Party came to power in a military coup on 8 March 1963. From that year onwards, teaching Kurdish in schools, using it in official institutions and speaking it in public were effectively prohibited. From the mid-1960s, language bans became part of policies aimed at changing the demographic structure through the “Arab Belt” project. In the 1980s, restrictions on the use of Kurdish in workplaces, at weddings and in public spaces were tightened further. These bans continued for around 49 years, until the Rojava Revolution in 2012.


The Interim Government’s decision to restrict Kurdish to three hours a week, effectively seeking to eliminate the language, is seen as another form of these historical policies of repression and assimilation. Protests, however, continue almost every day in cities including Kobanê, Qamishlo, Al-Malikiyah (Dêrik), Amuda (Amûdê), Al-Jawadiyah (Çilaxa), Zirgan, Al-Qahtaniyah (Tirbespiyê), Tell Tamer (Til Temir), Hasakah and Al-Muabbada (Girkê Legê). People protesting Damascus’s policy towards Kurdish say that such impositions can only be overcome through determined struggle and make clear that Kurds will not give up their language under any circumstances.


The debate over education has therefore developed into a broader political discussion over the extent to which Kurdish cultural and linguistic rights will be recognized within the new state structure.


What will happen to the universities?

Αφίσα/Κάλεσμα από τη

Συλλογικότητα για τον Κοινωνικο Αναρχισμό ” Μαύρο & Κόκκινο”:


ANΤΙΦΑΣΙΣΤΙΚΗ ΣΥΓΚΕΝΤΡΩΣΗ


ΠΑΡΑΣΚΕΥΗ 09/10, 18.30 ΚΑΜΑΡΑ


Χθες το βράδυ, στην Ελευσίνα, έν Οργανωνόμαστε συλλογικά, στεκόμαστε δίπλα σε όσους και όσες στοχοποιούνται και αντιστεκόμαστε έμπρακτα στην εξάπλωση του φασισμού.ας 32χρονος αντιφασίστας δέχθηκε επίθεση με μαχαίρι από ομάδα φασιστών.


Πέρασαν δεκατρία χρόνια από τη δολοφονία του Παύλου Φύσσα και η πραγματικότητα είναι ακόμη πιο ασφυκτική. Φτώχεια, εξαθλίωση, κρατική βία, ρατσισμός, κοινωνικός κανιβαλισμός, εκφασισμός. Ο εθνικιστικός κλοιός σφίγγει, ο ρατσισμός ξαναβρίσκει δημόσιο βήμα και η αποφυλάκιση του Κασιδιάρη υπενθυμίζει πως ο φασισμός δεν μπορεί ποτέ να ηττηθεί οριστικά στα πλαίσια της αστικής δημοκρατίας που όσο καμώνεται πως τον αποστρέφεται, τόσο απαραίτητος της είναι για την αναπαραγωγή του συστήματος που μας εξουσιάζει.


Εμείς αναρχικοί και αναρχικές, δεν περιμένουμε από τους θεσμούς να μας προστατεύσουν από τη βία που οι ίδιοι αναπαράγουν. Οργανωνόμαστε συλλογικά, στεκόμαστε δίπλα σε όσους και όσες στοχοποιούνται και αντιστεκόμαστε έμπρακτα στην εξάπλωση του φασισμού. Απέναντι στον φόβο, αντιτάσσουμε τη συλλογικοποίηση, την αυτοοργάνωση και την αλληλεγγύη· απέναντι στον κόσμο της εξουσίας, αγωνιζόμαστε για έναν κόσμο ελευθερίας και ισότητας.

title: Αντιφασιστική συγκέντρωση, Παρασκευή 9/10, στις 18:30 στην Καμάρα
content:
ΑΝΤΙΦΑΣΙΣΤΙΚΗ ΣΥΓΚΕΝΤΡΩΣΗ, ΚΑΜΑΡΑ, 18:30


Χθες το βράδυ στην Ελευσίνα, μια περιοχή στην οποία ιστορικά δώθηκαν σκληρές μάχες κατά των κρατικά επιδοτούμενων ταγμάτων εφόδου της ΧΑ, παραλίγο να επαναληφθή άλλη μία φασιστική δολοφονία με μαχαίρι. Καθώς 32χρονος αντιφασίστας σύντροφος έβγαινε απ΄το σπίτι του, δύο γνωστοί φασίστες της περιοχής -μέλη της νεοναζιστικής οργάνωσης Propatria- του έστησαν καρτέρι και του επιτέθηκαν. Ο σύντροφος δίνοντας μάχη κατάφερε να αντισταθεί και αυτό είχε ως αποτέλεσμα το ένα θρασίμι να βγάλει μαχαίρι, να καταφέρει κάποια χτυπήματα στα πόδια και να προσπαθήσει να τον μαχαιρώσει στο στήθος. Ο σύντροφος νοσηλέυτηκε στο Tζάνειο, όπου και ευτυχώς βρίσκεται εκτός κινδύνου.


ΕΠΕΙΔΗ ΤΑ ΠΟΛΛΑ ΛΟΓΙΑ ΕΙΝΑΙ ΦΤΩΧΕΙΑ…


Ουσιαστικά για λίγα εκατοστά δε δολοφονήθηκε ο σύντροφος.

 Άλλη μία φορά που ο φασιστικός και νεοναζιστικός οχετός λειτουργεί με όρους

καρτέρι

–

αριθμητική υπεροχή-μαχαίρι.

 Επειδή οι νέες γενιές φασιστών είναι

γαλουχημένες στα social media, συνιστούν δομικό κομμάτι του διάχυτου κοινωνικού κανιβαλισμού και εφυσυχάζονται όσο η πολιτική τους υπόσταση βασίζεται στην ελεημοσύνη δισεκατομμυριούχων, εφοπλιστών και πλανηταρχών, τους υποσχόμαστε το εξής :

Θα κάνουμε τις πόλεις μας κόλαση επί γης για τις μίζερες υπάρξεις τους.

 Ακόμα κι αν οι μπάτσοι, οι δημοσιογράφοι και το πολιτικό προσωπικό προσπαθούν να αποπολιτικοποιήσουν το συμβάν, οι αντιφασίστες και οι αντιφασίστριες είμαστε εδώ ώστε να μην μείνει αναπάντητο. Αρχικά το αφήγημα δε μπορεί να ελεγχθεί με ασφαλίτικες αναφορές σε ληστείες, προσωπικές διενέξεις και ρεπορτάζ με δράκους και πράσινα άλογα. Η δημοσιογραφική αλητεία καλλιεργεί καθημερινά καινούριους φασίστες, δαιμονοποιώντας ασταμάτητα όσους αντιστέκονται στην κεφαλαιοκρατική εξουσία ενώ ο κρατικός μηχανισμός έχει αφομοιώσει εξ’ολοκλήρου τις φασιστικές πρακτικές σε επίπεδο θεσμών, οικονομικής πολιτικής και αστυνόμευσης. Δεν έχει κανένα πολιτικό νόημα ο επικοινωνιακός διαχωρισμός του κράτους από την δολοφόνικη φασιστική ενόρμηση, δε πείθεται κανένας για το ποιόν της δημοκρατίας. Τα ίδια τα ανώτατα κλιμάκια της ιμπεριαλιστικής αυτοκρατορίας σιγοντάρουν πολιτικές δολοφονίες αντιφασιστών και ποινικοποίηση της αντιφασιστικής συγκρότησης. Από τις αναφορές του Μάρκο Ρούμπιο στην Πνύκα περί σπασίματος της “ενοχοποίησης του εθνικισμού”, μέχρι την αλληλεγγύη του Elon Musk στον Κασιδιάρη, από τους πνιγμούς μεταναστριών και την αδιανόητη σφαγή στην Παλαιστίνη μέχρι τους μαχαιροβγάλτες στην πόλη της Ελευσίνας,

να υποσχεθούμε στους εαυτούς μας να είμαστε συνεπείς στο ραντεβού με την ιστορία. Απαιτείται άμεσα αντιφασιστική επαγρύπνηση.


ΤΣΑΚΙΣΤΕ ΤΟΥΣ ΦΑΣΙΣΤΕΣ ΣΕ ΚΑΘΕ ΓΕΙΤΟΝΙΑ

author: Jimmy Kitiro
title: Faith, Belonging, and the Kenyan Sacred
content:
In a

recent edition

 of The Elephant, younger Kenyans voiced a growing dissatisfaction with the state of religion in public life. Their concern is not simply that religion has become political; it is that, in many instances, it has become too closely aligned with the state. Politicians continue to occupy pulpits, opaque fundraisers flourish, and a state-friendly theology often appears more concerned with legitimising power than confronting the hardship, corruption and inequality that shape ordinary Kenyan lives. During the 2024 Gen Z protests, this frustration crystallised in the #OccupyChurches movement, which challenged clergy and politicians who used religious spaces to legitimise unpopular economic policies and political authority.


Yet Kenya remains a profoundly religious country. The 2019 census found that about 85.5 per cent of Kenyans identified as Christian and 11 per cent as Muslim, and religious institutions still command large followings nationwide. Kenyans still flock to churches, mosques, crusades, prayer meetings and religious festivals, albeit for varied and sometimes contradictory reasons.


Some attend in search of spiritual refuge, healing, moral direction or hope. Others come for community, music, ritual, fellowship and a sense of belonging. There is also a more civic explanation. Wandia Njoya has argued that Kenya’s shortage of accessible “third spaces”, places beyond home and work where citizens can meet, converse and think together, may make religious gatherings one of the few widely available sites of collective life. Whether Kenyans fill religious sanctuaries because of faith, sociability, the search for meaning, or the absence of alternative public spaces remains an open question.


The Kenyan scholar John S. Mbiti famously observed that “Africans are notoriously religious,” arguing that religion is woven into the fabric of African social life rather than confined to private belief or weekly worship. In Kenya, this observation still resonates. Religion is not merely an institution; it is a language through which many Kenyans interpret suffering, aspiration, family, nationhood and public morality.


Here, photojournalist Jimmy Kitiro captures religious life across Kenya: the crowds, worship, prayer, evangelism, rituals and public performances of faith that continue to shape the country’s moral and civic imagination.


The recent Rhema Feast, organised by Reverend Julian Kyula, has become a major feature of Kenya’s Christian calendar. Held at Uhuru Park in Nairobi from 31 August to 4 September 2026, the five-day non-denominational gathering drew worshippers from across Kenya and the wider region for prayer, worship, teaching and spiritual renewal. Its scale is a testament to a population still craving religious experience, social belonging and public spaces in which to gather, hope and imagine change.


During the Rhema Feast, a young man raises his hands in praise and worship. Since the 2024 Occupy movement, the whistle has become a recognisable symbol of a generation reimagining Kenyan society and demanding accountability from both state and religious institutions.


Worship music remains a central form of religious expression in Kenya. A pianist leads a congregation in song, turning faith into a collective, emotional, and participatory experience.


Since the #OccupyChurches movement of 2024, Kenyan Christians have increasingly asserted a new sense of patriotic agency in public life. The church, too, has not been exempt from this scrutiny. A worshipper dons the Kenyan flag while attending the Rhema Feast, embodying a faith that is at once personal, national and politically self-aware.


A clergyman prays for a young family in a local congregation. Beyond public spectacle, religious life in Kenya is sustained through intimate acts of pastoral care, blessing, counselling and communal support.


From the late 1980s through the 1990s, crusades became emblematic of Kenya’s mushrooming tent churches—spaces that offered hope, fellowship and a sense of stability as the country underwent structural adjustment and economic hardship. Today, crusades remain part of Kenya’s religious landscape. A crusade unfolds in [location], drawing believers into a shared ritual of preaching, prayer and conversion.


Religion provides meaning and social belonging to many Kenyans. In this photograph, a young woman is ushered into a women’s group in a ceremony of transition. The moment evokes the biblical …

author: Redazione_web
title: Terzo Congresso CIT
content:
In questo articolo userò il femminile come forma inclusiva, intendendo con esso tutte le persone, indipendentemente dal genere.


Quando l’USI ha proposto alla CIT di fare un congresso straordinario, aveva ben chiaro in mente che vedersi, frequentarsi, dialogare in presenza, prendersi il tempo per decidere guardandosi in faccia è indispensabile per continuare a camminare e lottare insieme. È la necessità di condividere che ci ha indotte a invitare tutte le sezioni della CIT a raggiungerci nella campagna emiliana e a popolare per tre giorni le Cucine del Popolo di Massenzatico con le voci di tante persone, ognuna nella sua lingua, ognuna con la sua cultura, ognuna determinata a proseguire un percorso comune iniziato otto anni fa.


La CIT ha risposto a questa esigenza con entusiasmo e si è spesa affinché il suo terzo Congresso costituisse una tappa importante di questo viaggio internazionalista, che si rinnova sempre, al passo con le vicende che condizionano la vita delle lavoratrici di tutto il mondo. È proprio in Italia che ci siamo radunate nel maggio del 2018, a Parma, e abbiamo dato vita alla Confederación Internacional del Trabajo. Quel primo Congresso è stato l’apice di un percorso di ripensamento e rifondazione delle nostre ambizioni internazionaliste, perché per alcune delle organizzazioni che compongono l’Internazionale anarcosindacalista l’uscita dall’AIT non poteva assolutamente costituire la rinuncia a impegnarsi insieme, a prescindere dalle frontiere; le altre sezioni che dell’AIT non avevano avuto esperienza hanno abbracciato il nostro progetto e ne hanno condiviso la costruzione. Da allora la CIT ha vissuto al fianco delle lavoratrici che ne fanno parte, sperimentando momenti di stasi e di rilancio, crescendo non solo nel numero di affiliate, ma soprattutto nella consapevolezza che insieme si possono superare le difficoltà e i propri limiti.


L’USI ha proposto alla CIT di riunirsi a Massenzatico in prossimità di alcuni cambiamenti e nell’evidenza di alcune criticità: si prospettava una nuova tappa, un momento di svolta necessario a cui dedicare energie speciali, pur nell’urgenza che un congresso straordinario comporta.


E così ci siamo riunite: la CNT spagnola, con una numerosa delegazione e la sua consueta grinta; la CNT francese, sempre combattiva; la FAU tedesca, con la sua concretezza; la FORA argentina, piccola e tenace, in un contesto difficilissimo; l’IP polacca, che sta sperimentando una crescita senza precedenti; l’IWW tutta intera (ovvero le amministrazioni regionali di NARA nord America e WISERA, che fa capo alla Regno Unito, con tanti satelliti in territori diversi), che è in tante parti del mondo e ovunque porta la sua storia; l’USI-CIT, che su questo settimanale non ha bisogno di presentazioni. A queste delegazioni si sono aggiunte, purtroppo a distanza, le referenti delle nuovissime sezioni della CIT: FGWM del Myanmar e la FOB del Brasile. Ci hanno accompagnato, inoltre, come osservatrici la SAC svedese, Solidaridad Obrera e Mujeres Libres dalla Spagna, il sindacato palestinese PPSWU.


Il luogo in cui il Congresso si è svolto, le Cucine del Popolo di Massenzatico (Reggio Emilia), ci ha accolto in modo perfetto, dandoci spazi di incontro formale e informale, nutrendoci nel rispetto di ogni scelta ed esigenza alimentare, rallegrando le nostre serate, ma in particolare con la cura di Fillo, costantemente e discretamente dedito a risolvere ogni minimo problema potesse sorgere.


Ma al terzo Congresso della CIT abbiamo soprattutto risposto col dialogo alle esigenze che oggi la Confederazione ha, un dialogo a volte deciso e forse anche aspro, ma sempre autentico e mai brutale, sapendoci compagne e coscienti dell’importanza di avanzare una accanto all’altra.


A otto anni dalla fondazione della CIT abbiamo capito che l’organizzazione che ci siamo date sulla carta non teneva conto di dinamiche, contesti e occasioni che potessero venire a crearsi, a causa di eventi esterni così come di specificità interne alle sezioni. Insomma, come spesso accade, non avevamo previsto tutto e abbiamo sentito il bisogno di riorientare la nostra capacità di coordinazione e di dotarci di strumenti operativi nuovi. Abbiamo definito con maggiore cura il ruolo e le pratiche del Comitato per le Relazioni, che dà seguito alle indicazioni fornite dai congressi e coordina le attività e le iniziative; abbiamo riformulato le dinamiche interne ai gruppi di lavoro, lasciandoli liberi di organizzarsi al meglio secondo le …

author: Jéssica Ribeiro
title: Da sua mão para o crime organizado: o que acontece quando seu celular é roubado?
content:
Jonas Domenici, 55, ganhou de presente da mãe um iPhone 15, adquirido em um famoso marketplace que tem como slogan a expressão “compre com confiança”. Era julho de 2025 e o agrado, que custou R$ 4 mil, foi entregue sem demora em São Paulo. Quase um ano depois, já em junho de 2026, ele recebeu uma mensagem da Polícia Civil da Bahia (PCBA) informando que o aparelho havia sido identificado como possível objeto de crime e deveria ser entregue para averiguação em 72 horas, sob risco de indiciamento por receptação.


Assustado, Jonas tentou contato com a plataforma, mas não recebeu ajuda. Então, procurou uma delegacia, apresentou documentos da compra, mas teve que registrar a ocorrência e deixar o aparelho que usava com a polícia e voltar para casa de mãos vazias. “O reembolso pelo prejuízo só foi feito após eu procurar os meus direitos”, declarou. “E a plataforma ofereceu apenas créditos para serem utilizados dentro do próprio marketplace”, finaliza.


Jonas é apenas um dos mais de 51 mil brasileiros notificados por estarem com celulares roubados ou furtados no país.

 Um total de 9.989 aparelhos foram entregues em delegacias apenas entre 10 e 19 de agosto de 2026. De acordo com o Código Penal, as penas para o crime de receptação variam de um mês a um ano de detenção em caso de crime culposo (quando não houve intenção) e pode chegar a 8 anos no caso, por exemplo, de revenda desses aparelhos.


Em 2025, conforme o Fórum Brasileiro de Segurança Pública, 830 mil celulares foram subtraídos – 95 por cada hora. Os caminhos percorridos pelos aparelhos após serem retirados de seus proprietários apontam para uma cadeia que pode envolver, além da comercialização dos celulares, sua reutilização, a permuta por drogas e até mesmo o escoamento para outros países, segundo informou o secretário Nacional de Segurança Pública, Francisco Lucas Costa Veloso.


“[Os celulares também podem] ser utilizados para fraudes financeiras, acesso indevido a serviços e comprometimento de dados e identidades digitais”, explica. “Não existe um percurso único”

, pontua o secretário, logo após afirmar que as subtrações ocorrem principalmente pelo valor econômico do aparelho no mercado ilícito.


Dados da

20ª edição do Anuário Brasileiro de Segurança Pública (FBSP)

 mostram que a taxa de ocorrências de roubo e furto de celulares no país é de 371,2 casos para cada 100 mil habitantes. Os dados históricos mostram uma queda nos roubos — cometidos mediante ameaça ou violência direta — e um leve aumento nos furtos, que representam 60% desses crimes, concentrados fortemente nos grandes centros urbanos.


20 municípios com as maiores taxas de aparelhos roubados ou furtados a cada 100 mil habitantes


MARANHÃO

PARÁ

SÃO PAULO

BAHIA

RONDÔNIA

PERNAMBUCO

PIAUIÍ

ESPÍRITO SANTO

MINAS GERAIS

RIO GRANDE DO NORTE

CEARÁ

RIO DE JANEIRO


Entre os 20 municípios com as maiores taxas de celulares roubados por 100 mil habitantes, 14 são capitais – com São Luís, Belém e São Paulo aparecendo do pódio.

 Amazonas, Amapá, Pará, Pernambuco, Distrito Federal, Rondônia, São Paulo, Maranhão, Espírito Santo e Bahia aparecem entre as dez unidades da Federação com as maiores taxas dessas ocorrências.


O tema “segurança pública” se tornou uma das principais bandeiras de campanha eleitoral para o pleito de 2026. Nos programas de governo apresentados ao Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE), os candidatos à Presidência da República Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva e Flávio Bolsonaro, que disputam o segundo turno, defendem diferentes caminhos para enfrentar a insegurança no país.


Segundo a pesquisa encomendada pelo FBSP, 78,8% dos brasileiros afirmam temer que o celular seja roubado ou furtado.

O receio de cair em um golpe pela internet ou pelo próprio aparelho é ainda maior: atinge 83,2% da população. O medo começa a modificar hábitos e comportamentos.

 A liberdade de circulação dos cidadãos passa a ser condicionada pela percepção de risco, especialmente em locais e horários considerados mais “arriscados”.


Para o doutor em direito e mestre em antropologia social Welliton Caixeta Maciel, além do alto preço que é pago por determinados modelos de celular, considerado essencial na vida das pessoas, os dados que constam nos aparelhos atraem a atenção de criminosos


“[Quando um celular é subtraído,] criminosos passam a ter acesso a dados, às informações bancárias e acesso às redes sociais das vítimas”, disse. Para o especialista, o vazamento de informações sensíveis …

author: Unknown
title: Non à la tenue des salons de l'Alyah en France !
content:
En octobre prochain se tiendront à

Lyon, Marseille et Paris des salons de l'alyah

. L'alyah, terme qui signifie “ascension” en hébreu, désigne l'acte pour un-e Juif-ve d'immigrer en Israël et constitue l'un des piliers de la politique sioniste de colonisation de la Palestine. Originellement, dans la mystique juive, le terme alyah évoque l'ascension spirituelle de l'âme, et aucunement une situation d'émigration matérielle. Dans les prières juives, la formule “l'an prochain à Jérusalem” est régulièrement invoquée, mais celle-ci évoque une rédemption prochaine de l'âme et non une migration véritable. Les sionistes ont perverti ce concept spirituel en en faisant l'un des piliers de la colonisation en Palestine, créant une fallacieuse “loi du retour” permettant aux personnes juives ayant au moins un grand-parent juif, ainsi qu'à leurs conjoints, de s'installer en Palestine occupée et d'acquérir la citoyenneté israélienne.


Cette “loi du retour” dénuée de fondements s'inscrit en contradiction totale avec le droit au retour

, lui bien réel et toujours nié par le gouvernement sioniste,

des Palestinien-nes chassé-e-s de leurs terres

.

Il s'agit donc d'un véritable salon de recrutement colonial destiné à accélérer le nettoyage ethnique des Palestinien-nes et à étendre les territoires colonisés.


L'organisateur principal de ce salon est l'Agence Juive pour Israël (

AJPI

). Cette dernière a joué un rôle central dans l'implantation des colonies sionistes en Palestine dès l'époque du mandat britannique avant 1948. Travaillant en étroite collaboration avec le Fonds National Juif, créé en 1901 et gérant historique des terres volées aux propriétaires palestinien-nes chassé-e-s, l'Agence Juive œuvre à l'installation de colons sur l'ensemble du territoire de la Palestine afin d'exercer une pression démographique et économique sur les Palestinien-nes, pour les pousser au départ. Ainsi, le programme d'alyah collective “Alyah Lekh Lekha”, qui a son propre stand dans ces salons de l'alyah, invite les aspirants immigrants à “sauter dans l'avion d'El Al pour rejoindre la Terre qui [leur] appartient”. Leur brochure invite ses bénéficiaires à s'installer dans des localités comme Alon Shvout ou Tal Menashe, colonies en Cisjordanie occupée. Ce programme est soutenu par l'association Israel is Forever, très proche du gouvernement de Netanyahou, et dont la présidente Nili Kupfer fait l'objet en France d'un mandat d'amener pour ses actions de blocage de l'aide humanitaire à destination de Gaza.


Depuis le 7 octobre 2023, de nombreux salons de ce type se sont déroulés en toute impunité dans plusieurs villes françaises, tandis que le décompte des victimes palestiniennes allait croissant. En juillet 2026, l'

ONU

 publiait les chiffres effroyables de 73 000 morts dont 21 600 enfants, 1,4 million de personnes déplacées, 660 000 enfants privés d'éducation et plus de 100 000 enfants exposés à un risque de malnutrition aigüe. Ce salon de recrutement colonial est d'autant plus aberrant lorsque l'on sait que 92% des habitations et 96% des terres agricoles gazaouies ont été détruites.


Alors, que fait la France

 

? Tandis que le ministre des Affaires étrangères Jean-Noël Barrot affirmait récemment avec un aplomb sans pareil que la France a fait plus “pour la cause palestinienne” que n'importe quel autre Etat du monde, la député Caroline Yadan vient de déposer un amendement visant à allouer 500 000 euros d'argent public pour aider les familles françaises installées en Palestine occupée. Dans le même temps, les réfugiés palestiniens demandant l'asile en France sont accueillis au compte-goutte, et les chaînes du service public censurent les voix s'élevant pour la Palestine, comme l'illustre l'exemple récent d'Adèle Haenel censurée par France Télévision. La tenue de ces salons de la colonisation n'est donc que l'énième élément d'une politique française ouvertement sioniste et impérialiste.


Enfin, en suggérant que les Juif-ves n'auraient pas leur place en France, ces salons alimentent un message antisémite entretenu par des discours islamophobes et antipalestiniens

. Comme toute lutte antiraciste, la lutte contre l'antisémitisme doit s'inscrire dans un mouvement global de libération de toutes et de tous.


Nous, militant-e-s antiracistes, antifascistes et anticolonialistes, refusons la tenue de cet événement honteux

 

! Nous vous appelons à interpeller vos élus, à parler de ce salon autour de vous et à soutenir les organisations luttant pour …

author: Unknown
title: Narges Mohammadi’s health deteriorates in Iranian prison
content:
The health of imprisoned Iranian human rights activist and 2023 Nobel Peace Prize laureate Narges Mohammadi has reportedly deteriorated.


Mohammadi, who has been under medical supervision in hospital for about a week due to a heart condition, is in increasingly poor health, according to new information shared by her lawyer.


Her lawyer said Mohammadi had lost 20 kilograms and was struggling to speak. The lawyer said, “She has difficulty speaking, and the appearance of her head and face has changed.”


‘Her health is deteriorating with every passing minute’


Mohammadi's lawyer said she was being held under tight security at a hospital in northeastern Iran, adding: “Her health is deteriorating with every passing minute.”


Human rights activists have demanded that Mohammadi be transferred as soon as possible to a fully equipped hospital in Tehran, where she can receive treatment from specialist medical teams.


Treatment in Tehran is being blocked


Narges Mohammadi, who was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize in 2023, was arrested in January 2025 during the funeral of lawyer Khosrow Ali Kordi in Mashhad and was subsequently sentenced to prison.


Mohammadi suffered a heart-related medical emergency at Zanjan Prison on 1 May. Her health has reportedly failed to improve since then and has continued to deteriorate.


Iranian regime forces have reportedly prevented Mohammadi from receiving treatment at a hospital in Tehran.

title: Comme des éclaircies dans les nuages de lacrymos (tract)
content:
Tract à imprimer et diffuser, en solidarité avec les révoltes en cours.


(8 oct 2026)


(Les pdf sont en bas de l'article)


Comme des éclaircies dans les nuages de lacrymos


La révolte est partie d'un lycée de banlieue parisienne

 mi septembre, et s'est étendue en traînée de poudre, devant les bahuts et dans les rues. Les blocages et les barricades se sont fait écho en solidarité à travers tout le territoire dominé par l'État Français, en métropole comme dans les "anciennes" colonies (

DOM

-

TOM

).


On sort à peine d'un été passé à suffoquer de la catastrophe écologique en cours, pendant que le fascisme et la guerre nous sont matraquées comme seules perspectives d'avenir.

 Alors c'est clair que ça fait une grosse bouffée d'air de voir ce refus et cette rage sortir, et les désirs d'un autre monde s'exprimer

 

!


Les raisons de se révolter sont déjà là et s'accumulent, depuis bien trop longtemps. Cette fois, la tempête n'a pas attendu une nouvelle loi ou un nouveau meurtre policier auquel réagir

 pour se déclencher. Le pire qu'on nous promet est déjà là. Et c'est pas celles et ceux qui nous ont foutu dans cette merde (ou leurs pseudos-adversaires politiciens) qui vont nous en sortir

 

!


Le pouvoir flippe de ce vent d'insoumission de la jeunesse qu'il n'avait pas vu venir

, et qui prend des formes bien plus difficiles à contrôler que les défilés tout bien encadrés et muselés de ses partenaires syndicaux. Et on espère qu'ils ont raison d'avoir peur

 

! :)


Bon nombre de lycéennes et lycéens revendiquent leur autonomie, refusent la récupération des politiciens de tout bords, et s'auto-organisent pour faire vivre leurs luttes, qui sont bien plus larges et profondes que la question des conditions matérielles dans les lycées.


Face à ces imaginaires qui ouvrent tant d'autres possibles, l'État met les moyens pour refermer la brèche et forcer tout le monde à rentrer dans ses rangs.

 En interdisant jusqu'au matériel de protection face aux armes de la police, le message est clair.


La machine Police/Justice joue son rôle habituel pour défendre ce système : des milliers d'arrestations, des mutilations, des enfermements et des condamnations pour traumatiser les corps et les esprits. Tout ça entouré de discours dégueulasses, remplis d'un mépris adulte, bourge, raciste et sexiste (entre autre).


Les récupérateurs sont appelés à la rescousse pour recadrer la lutte en manifs pacifistes, en revendications avec des "représentants" (et autres petits-chefs) du mouvement qui dialogueraient avec l'État.


Et pour légitimer la répression, tout le monde devrait se désolidariser des actes qui ne rentrent pas dans le cadre de contestation toléré par le pouvoir.


Mais de quelle violence on parle

 

?


Ce système qui détruit la vie et écrase tout sur son passage ne va pas s'arrêter avec des pétitions et des bulletins de vote.


Alors oui c'est beau et inspirant ce débordement.


Et ça donne de la force

 

!


Ça fout la patate de voir ce soulèvement qui répond à d'autres à travers le monde ces dernières années, et par delà les frontières meurtrières que ce système nous impose.


Ça fait plaisir de voir des moments ou les oppositions mensongères entre «

 

gentils-manifestants-lycéens-légitimes

 

» et «

 

méchants-casseurs-extérieurs

 

» volent en éclat.


Ça fait du bien de voir ces joies sur les visages, des élans euphoriques sur les barricades enflammées entre 2 battles de danses, des cours en visio sabotés par des cris ininterrompus, des «

 

Siamo tutti antifascisti

 

» et «

 

À Bas l'État, les flics et les fachos

 

» repris en chœurs, comme de l'entraide et de la prise de soin au milieu des affrontements avec les keufs.


Quand des portes solidaires s'ouvrent pour planquer des personnes pourchassées ou blessées par les flics, que des voisin.e.s filent des bouteilles d'eau ou des masques par les fenêtres, et que des meufs et des queers sont présent.e.s en nombre, déters et solidaires dans les émeutes.


On dirait que ça ne va pas être si simple que prévu de mettre en place leur grand plan national de militariser la jeunesse,

 et la faire tranquillement mourir au service de l'État et du Capitalisme… Le chef des armées françaises dit que le pays doit être prêt à «

 

accepter de perdre ses enfants

 

», nous on lui répondrait plutôt d'aller crever tout seul au front si il tient tant à sa guerre

 

!


Ces derniers jours, et sans rien attendre de personne, une partie de la jeunesse a eu le courage …

title: Il y a 8 ans les gilets jaunes. Aujourd'hui...
content:
Jeudi 15 octobre à 19h, causerie à partir du mouvement de gilets jaunes à la bibliothèque anarchiste du 19 rue Burnouf (Paris 19

e

)


La révolte des gilets jaunes a été un formidable événement aussi complexe qu'hétérogène, aussi riche en contenus et en pratiques que riche en contradictions. Presque huit années se sont écoulées depuis, pourtant nous faisons le pari qu'il en reste quelque chose, de la même manière que d'autres soulèvements ailleurs dans le monde ont semé quelque chose ici, comme par un jeu de vases communicants.


L'autre pari que nous faisons est que la situation sociale, politique et économique actuelle alimente une poudrière vouée tôt ou tard à exploser. Il y aura du bon et du mauvais dans cela. Autant ne pas attendre que cette poudrière prenne feu pour affûter notre compréhension de l'époque actuelle, et alimenter par la réflexion et la discussion nos perspectives anarchistes.


C'est à partir de ces deux prémisses que nous vous invitons à cette causerie, une occasion entre autres pour discuter autant à partir de ce qu'a été la révolte des gilets jaunes que de ce qu'elle n'a pas été mais aurait pu être, pour chercher en quelque sorte à conjuguer le passé au présent.


Nous suggérons la lecture de ces deux brochures disponibles à la bibliothèque : «

 

Recueil de textes anarchistes à propos du mouvement des gilets jaunes (février-juin 2019)

 

» (disponible ici :

https://sansnom.nublogs.org/files/2020/10/brochgj.pdf

) et «

 

Sur le mouvement des gilets jaunes, l'intervention révolutionnaire et d'autres choses encore

 

» (disponible ici :

https://sansnom.nublogs.org/files/2023/08/Sur-le-mouvement-des-gilets-jaunes-lintervention-revolutionnaire-et-dautres-choses-encore.pdf

).


La discussion aura lieu à la bibliothèque anarchiste du 19 rue Burnouf, dans le 19

e

 arrondissement (Métro Belleville ou Colonel Fabien)

A Quisling regime installed in Venezuela under US military supervision. Bombs raining down in Gaza, Iran and Lebanon.  The U.S. has by far the largest military in the world, and one which has for many, many years rained down terror on hospitals, schools, and also some brutal thugs. It deliberately murders people, including several citizens. It routinely commits war crimes, and is now threatening new war crimes on a scale not seen since World War II.

If politicians did not have this enormous killing machine at their disposal they could not inflict this terrorism regardless of their homicidal tendencies.


 We can’t afford this global rain of death. It undermines the security of everyone on the planet.

title: Ephéméride des luttes : 9 octobre
content:
La Canebière est à l'honneur dans l'éphéméride des luttes du 9 octobre. Mais dans l'ensemble, cette date est à marquer du sceau de la répression. On sait qu'elle sera toujours là, mais ce n'est pas une raison pour renoncer à la lutte.


1886 :

 Aux Etats-Unis, les anarchistes de Haymarket sont condamnés à mort.


1909 :

 - A Barcelone, Francisco Ferrer, anarchiste qui avait développé les écoles modernes libérées du poids de la religion, passe devant la cour martiale et est condamné à mort. Il sera fusillé à Montjuïc le 13 octobre.


 A Nice, parution du premier numéro du journal anarchiste en espagnol 'Tierra Y Libertad'. Ce journal édité en France est ensuite acheminé clandestinement vers l'Espagne, où il est interdit.


1934 :

 A

Marseille

, sur la Canebière, un membre de l'Organisation Révolutionnaire de Macédonie Interne assassine le roi Alexandre Ie de Yougoslavie et le ministre des Affaires Etrangères français Louis Barthou.


1967 :

 Guevara est assassiné dans la jungle bolivienne après son arrestation

la veille

.


1969 :

 A Chicago, la garde nationale est appelée pour contenir la foule qui vient participer aux manifestations de soutien au procès des huit de Chicago.


1975 :

 - En Irlande du Nord, près de Crossmaglen, l'IRA fait sauter des explosifs qui tuent un soldat de l'armée britannique d'occupation.


 A Londres, l'IRA fait sauter une bombe près de la station de métro de Green Park.


1977 :

 A Rome, une charge de dynamite explose au bar 'Ciampini', lieu de retrouvailles des fascistes. Plus tard dans la nuit, une autre explosion a lieu devant les locaux du Front de la Jeunesse, une organisation d'extrême-droite.


1981 :

 En France, abolition de la peine de mort.


1982 :

 A Corio Canavese près de Turin, le groupe 'Potere Rosso' (Pouvoir Rouge) revendique la fusillade qui a coûté la vie à un vice-brigadier des carabiniers lors d'un contrôle routier. Les auteurs de l'attaque sont cependant vite retrouvés car la voiture utilisée appartenait à l'un d'entre eux.


1990 :

 En Irlande du Nord, deux membres de l'IRA sont abattus par des membres de services secrets britanniques.


2013 :

 En France, début des nouvelles générations de mobilisation lycéennes avec l'expulsion d'une famille du pays, ce qui devient vite "L'affaire Leonarda" du fait de la grande solidarité mise en place par les lycéen-ne-s.


Voir

l'éphéméride anarchiste

author: Kodao Productions
title: Ignorant of History or Indifferent to Genocide?
content:
By

Ina Alleco Silverio


The expectation that public figures must adhere to standard protocols of diplomatic engagement—meeting foreign envoys, exchanging pleasantries, and invoking the polite fiction and illusion of international respectability—collapses when applied to a state accused of ongoing, well-documented genocide and ecocide.


When a government actively violates the foundational conventions of human existence, conventional diplomacy stops being neutral; it becomes complicity. Upholding “decorum” or cultural norms like “pakikisama” in the presence of an official representative of such a state turns ethics into a hollow performance. It prioritizes institutional comfort over human survival, treating mass atrocities as mere disagreements in foreign policy rather than absolute moral crises.


True moral clarity requires a fundamental shift in how we understand diplomatic behavior!


There is an obvious difference, but a thin line between complicity and neutrality. Traditional diplomacy assumes that meeting an ambassador signals openness or dialogue. In the context of annihilation, however, normalization grants impunity. Refusing such meetings is not a failure of diplomacy; it is a necessary boundary-setting that rejects the sanitization of war crimes.


And yes, there are limits to civility! This is not the plot of a Jane Austen novel. We do not live in a period where the ability to maintain civility even under duress was the measure of  person’s manners.  When thousands of babies, young children, doctors, scientists, artists, engineers, teachers, athletes, and journalists are systematically targeted, maimed, starved, GENOCIDED, the polite rituals of state visits and official catch-ups become morally untenable. Civility cannot coexist with the erasure of an entire population’s right to exist. Repeat that: CIVILITY CANNOT CO-EXIST WITH THE ERASURE OF AN ENTIRE POPULATION AND THEIR CULTURE!


Palestine is the ultimate deal-breaker when it comes to issues of diplomacy (and even personal friendships and relationships,

maniwala ka!

) The crisis in Palestine is not a localized territorial dispute; it represents a profound moral fracture for the international community. The scale of devastation—shattering lives from infants to the elderly, dismantling hospitals, and destroying civilian infrastructure—challenges the very core of what it means to possess a conscience!


Israel’s genocide in Palestine is also a “no-brainer” litmus test for compassion. For anyone whose heart and intellect are aligned with human rights, genocide is an absolute line engraved in stone. There are no geopolitical nuances, historical complexities, or diplomatic justifications that can rationalize the obliteration of a people.


And what about the utter disdain for international humanitarian law? The ongoing impunity enjoyed by the Israel Occupation Forces (IOF) exposes how weak Philippine leaders are when it comes to implementing and enforcing global human rights frameworks.


When international humanitarian laws are breached every second without decisive intervention or even the slightest expression of opposition or protest, silence or polite engagement from prominent leaders sends a dangerous message that justice is conditional!


When leaders like Leni Robredo choose the path of conventional politeness over moral outrage, it forces a painful reassessment. Compassion and intelligence cannot be compartmentalized; they cannot guide domestic aspirations for good governance while remaining blind to systemic atrocities overseas. Standing against genocide requires stepping outside the comfortable confines of diplomacy and recognizing that some lines, once crossed, demand an uncompromising refusal to shake hands or take a photo-op shot.


Ignorant of History or Indifferent to Genocide?


But Robredo’s decision to meet with the Israeli ambassador was not a random thing. She has had dealings with Israel before.


In April 2023—just a few months before the world bore witness to the full-scale escalation of atrocities in Gaza that began in October of that same year—Robredo traveled to Israel with her college dorm mates from the University of the Philippines. She posted on her social media accounts her reflections on the trip, and they expose an unsettling disconnect between spiritual tourism and the bloody geopolitical reality of the land she visited.

author: Unknown
title: Samuel Edward Konkin III - An Agorist Primer
content:
Author

: Samuel Edward Konkin III

Title

: An Agorist Primer

Date

: 2008

Notes

: * If this area of study appeals to you, by all means go to the source: Human Action by Ludwig Von Mises. You’ll find all the terms starred herein are derived and defined in detail.

Source

: Retrieved on 2026-10-08 from https://archive.org/stream/SEK3_AnAgoristPrimer/An_Agorist_Primer_by_SEK3_djvu.txt


DEDICATION


 This book is dedicated to

 Teny Rule Fisher, Thelma Rule, and John Fragnito,

 without whom this book would not have happened.


 Most of all, though, this book is dedicated to my son,

 Samuel Edward Konkin IV,

 to whom I offer this blueprint for liberty as his legacy.


PREFACE


 Ideas evolve and grow. At some point, an idea connects with so many other concepts that it becomes central to a way of thinking — an ideology.


 At some state of an ideology’s life, between its birth and death, it reaches a level of maturity such that someone is motivated to divert his efforts from expanding it outward and upward and begins to look downward. That is, the theoretician pauses to pass on the knowledge to those not specializing in theoretical development. Perhaps the theoretician is reminded for whom he developed the ideology in the first place.


 Agorism is a way of thinking about the world around you, a method of understanding why things work the way they do, how they do, and how they can be dealt with — how you can deal with them


 Agorism was meant to improve the lot of everyone, not a chosen elite or unwashed underclass. Hence an introductory work that presents ideas without going through the long intellectual history and conflict of competing ideas that produced them. As the creator of agorism, it is most incumbent on me first to attempt to reduce it to basic intelligibility. I hope my efforts find some small reward.


 — Samuel Edward Konkin III


PUBLISHER’S NOTE


 Samuel Edward Konkin III wrote An Agorist Primer in 1986. A small number of Xerox copies were circulated to investors in the hope that they would finance the publication of a high-quality, hardcover edition. Though some money was raised, it proved insufficient to produce the book. Even though the photocopies bore text reading “First Edition”, it was meant to refer to the proposed hardback edition. This, then — the book you hold in your hands — is the true first edition as SEK3 intended it.


 An effort has been made to update the book in order to keep it relevant, though none of the timeless — and timely — agorist philosophy has been altered. Such archaic terms as “videotapes” and “cassettes” have been replaced by “DVDs” and “downloads”. Information about major wars since 1986 have been added, staying — we hope — in the spirit of SEK3’s other analyses. Notice has been taken of the collapse of Communism, brought about in no small part by Counter-Economics.


 Any mistakes, failures to catch archaisms, or errors of analysis added to the original text are entirely the fault of the current editor and not of the late author.


 — V.K.


INTRODUCTION


 Agorism can be defined simply: it is thought and action consistent with freedom.The moment one deals with “thinking,” “acting,” “consistency,” and especially “freedom,” things get more and more complex.


 Hold on to the virtue of consistency. The refusal to compromise, to deceive oneself, to “sell out” or to “be realistic” created agorism. Consider “being realistic.” This usually implies that theory is fine for thinking, but in practice one must deal with reality. Agorists believe that any theory which does not describe reality is either useless or a deliberate attempt by intellectuals to defraud non-specialists.


 When someone urges you to be realistic, may you pick an agorist book to get the best description you can find of how agorism actually works. If you want to find books and articles that will “fake reality” for wishes, whims, fears, and spite, look for labels such as “Liberal,” “Conservative,” “Socialist,” “Communist,” “Fascist,” or — worst of all — “middle of the road” and “moderate.”


 Reality knows no moderation; it is — all the way.


 One way of thinking came close to agorism and is fairly well-known today; we will deal with Libertarianism later in some detail. An ideology of Liberty, it had to choose at one point between consistency with reality and being the “politics of liberty.” It chose the latter: the contradiction of seeking political power over others to eliminate political power …

title: Milei, Caputo y Bausili perdieron mil millones de dólares en una “timba” con el oro
content:
Lo reveló el último reporte de la Auditoría General de la Nación, que analizó los estados contables de la entidad financiera hasta el 2025 y descubrió la pérdida a raíz de operaciones financieras en las que utilizaron parte del oro de las reservas como bien de respaldo.


Finalmente se supo cuánto le costó a la Argentina la decisión del equipo económico de Javier Milei de sacar el oro del Banco Central fuera del país: más de mil millones de dólares. La Auditoría General de la Nación (AGN) informó este jueves que completó la auditoría de los estados contables del Banco Central de la República Argentina (BCRA) hasta el 31 de diciembre de 2025 y reveló errores en el cálculo del precio del oro por parte de la gestión del titular de la entidad, Santiago Bausilli, lo que provocó pérdidas por “USD 1.023 millones”.


“En síntesis: durante el 2025 el BCRA realizó operaciones financieras especulando con una determinada trayectoria para el precio internacional del oro, erró el cálculo y perdió USD 1.023 millones, según surge de las registraciones contables”, remarcó el titular de la AGN, Juan Manuel Olmos.


Y agregó: “Desde que se auditan los Estados Contables del BCRA, nunca se había utilizado esta magnitud de reservas físicas (oro) para transacciones de riesgo, como las mencionadas operaciones de derivados que han generado una pérdida de más de USD 1.000 millones para la entidad”.


El informe incluyó un señalamiento sobre el resultado de las operaciones vinculadas a las reservas de oro. Olmos remarcó que durante el ejercicio 2025, la tenencia de oro, que fueron adquiridas en las gestiones de Alfonso Prat Gay y Mercedes Marco del Pont en la entidad financiera, registró una ganancia patrimonial de más de 8 billones de pesos, explicada solamente por la suba internacional del precio del metal.


Olmos informó que bajo la gestión de Bausilli en 2025 y “con fines de cobertura, el BCRA concertó operaciones de derivados liquidables en dólares utilizando parte del oro de las reservas como bien de respaldo (subyacente)”, por lo que “de acuerdo con los estados contables, el resultado de estas operaciones arrojó una pérdida de 1.5 billones de pesos (equivalentes a USD 1.023 millones), que se pagó con divisas”. Según remarcó, “al cierre del ejercicio auditado ya no existían posiciones u operaciones abiertas por este concepto”.


El titular de la AGN aclaró que el organismos “se encuentra trabajando en la auditoría específica sobre la gestión de las reservas físicas (de oro) por parte del BCRA”, en el que “se podrá saber por qué se tomó la decisión de trasladar el oro al exterior, a dónde fue enviado y si tuvo algún beneficio específico para el país o, en su defecto, quien se benefició. Dicho informe se encuentra desde hoy, en el BCRA para su descargo.

title: Gaza: tres años intentando sobrevivir al presente
content:
Cada gazatí ha sido marcado de manera distinta por la pérdida de la posibilidad de una vida ordinaria. En Gaza, las familias han sufrido pérdidas que no pueden reducirse a una sola estadística: casas destruidas, seres queridos muertos o heridos, medios de vida perdidos, niños sin escuela y años de recuerdos ligados a lugares que ya no existen.


Por Sara Awad


Para las personas que vivíamos en Gaza, la mañana del 7 de octubre de 2023 comenzó con incertidumbre. Los teléfonos empezaron a sonar y empezaron a llegar mensajes. Lo primero que todos hicimos fue comprobar que nuestros seres queridos estaban bien, que todo el mundo estaba a salvo. No había manera de saberlo; tampoco sabíamos, en aquellas primeras horas, que la violencia continuaría no durante días o semanas, sino durante años. Para abordar lo que ocurrió en octubre de 2023 y lo que vino después, sin embargo, resulta necesario situar ese día dentro de la historia de

Palestina

.


Para los y las palestinas, la historia no comenzó el 7 de octubre de 2023, sino que se remonta a 1948, cuando la creación del Estado de Israel vino acompañada del desplazamiento de cientos de miles de palestinos, un hecho que los palestinos llaman la Nakba, o “catástrofe”. Esto es central para entender que ha ido sucediendo en las décadas posteriores.


Vivir entre la violencia en Gaza era ya, antes de octubre de 2023, una especie de “normalidad”. Los palestinos nos hemos acostumbrado a sufrir agresiones por parte de Israel. En Gaza ha habido seis grandes rondas de agresión, todas ellas en momentos distintos pero con el mismo objetivo: la destrucción de un enclave habitado por unos dos millones de personas hacinadas en 365 kilómetros cuadrados. Esos dos millones de personas se despertaron el 7 de octubre con rutinas, vidas e historias distintas, pero terminaron el día enfrentándose al mismo trauma y a la misma conmoción.


¿Qué ocurrió aquella mañana?


Si uno se acerca a Gaza desde una perspectiva política, se verá nadando entre innumerables narrativas e interpretaciones distintas; pero estas líneas no persiguen este objetivo, sino acercarse a Gaza desde un punto de vista puramente humano; desde la perspectiva de la humanidad misma y de lo que sucede cuando se despoja a las personas de esa humanidad.


Ya desde antes, pero con más intensidad desde el 7 de octubre de 2023, en Gaza, la magnitud de la muerte y el sufrimiento se ha convertido en algo con lo que la gente se ve obligada a convivir cada día. Cuando matar se vuelve una realidad cotidiana, existe el peligro de que incluso la pérdida de cien vidas empiece a parecer una cifra más en las noticias, en lugar de cien seres humanos concretos, cada uno con una familia, una historia y una vida. Según el Ministerio de Salud de Gaza, al menos entre 75.000 y 77.000 palestinos han muerto en Gaza desde el 7 de octubre.


La magnitud de la muerte es casi imposible de comprender y el costo humano es inmenso. Sin embargo, más allá de las vidas perdidas, hay otro costo que soportan quienes siguen vivos en el enclave y que tiene que ver con la pérdida de hogares, de escuelas, de hospitales, de universidades, de barrios y de los lugares que antes conformaban la vida cotidiana.


A lo largo de estos tres años, en toda Gaza, más de 201.000 estructuras han sufrido daños —de las cuales más de 134.000 se consideran como totalmente destruidas. Más de 328.000 unidades de vivienda han resultado dañadas. En el ámbito de la educación, 526 de los 564 edificios escolares del territorio requieren reconstrucción total o una rehabilitación importante; mientras que más de 63 edificios universitarios han sido destruidos. Más de la mitad de los hospitales de Gaza ya no funcionan.


¿Y si esto nunca hubiera ocurrido?


Gaza ha cambiado en casi todos los aspectos de la vida de la ciudadanía palestina. Estos tres años de

genocidio

han dinamitado la estabilidad económica, la seguridad física, la educación y, sobre todo, la vida emocional de las personas. Cada uno de los aproximadamente dos millones de habitantes de Gaza se ha visto afectado de manera distinta. Para algunos, la pregunta no es solo qué han perdido, sino en quién podrían haberse convertido si esto nunca hubiera ocurrido. ¿Qué habría pasado con esas vidas y futuros imaginados antes de la guerra? ¿Qué clase de vida intentan los gazatíes construir ahora?
