author: Unknown
title: Karasu: Once Öcalan’s freedom is secured, the conspiracy will be completely defeated
content:
In the second part of this interview with

Medya Haber

, KCK Executive Council member Mustafa Karasu said that the aim of the conspiracy against Abdullah Öcalan on 9 October 1998, was to completely dismantle the Freedom Movement. He said that the political approach pursued by Leader Apo, and the prospect of resolving the Kurdish question on a democratic basis, would weaken the collaborative foundations on which the United States and other external powers relied, and that the International Conspiracy was therefore carried out by the United States and Israel.


The first part of this in-depth interview can be read

here

.


We are approaching the 28th anniversary of the international conspiracy against Kurdish people’s leader Abdullah Öcalan, which started on 9 October 1998, and concluded on 15 February 1999. What kind of approach and stance towards the international conspiracy, given the current political juncture, do you see as appropriate?


Before answering these questions, I must mention our very dear comrades who were martyred in October. They were pioneered by the comrades Gurbetelli Ersöz (8 October 1997), Nagihan Akarsel (4 October 2022), and Bêrîtan (25 October 1992), who fell as martyrs in the month of October. I knew comrade Gurbetelli Ersöz personally. While we were in prison, she would regularly attend our meetings. Later, she was assigned to work in the press, and we maintained contact during her time in Europe. She was a good friend, and I knew her well. Truly a conscious comrade. She had strong patriotic feelings and was a person who had a good understanding of Rêber Apo [Kurdish people’s leader Abdullah Öcalan] and the movement. When she first came to prison, she hadn’t yet fully joined the movement as a cadre. At that time, she was still in college, but she was already actively involved. She had actually decided to join but still had academic work to complete at the university. Later, she took on responsibilities in the press and truly shaped the press work.


During the 1990s, when our movement was developing, the role of the press was extremely important. The press’s coverage of our struggle truly made significant contributions to the development of the struggle. Particularly in this regard, our comrade Gurbetelli played a very important role. She laid the foundation for our press, shaped its spirit, and defined its perspective. Gurbetelli Ersöz is a pioneer of the press within the freedom movement. It is therefore that our press academy today is named the ‘Gurbetelli Ersöz Academy.’ Press activities, the academy, and the training programs are all conducted in the name of our comrade Gurbetelli. She holds a truly vital place in our struggle, and still today her stance is of great importance to us. After her work for the press in Europe, she came to the guerrillas. Her participation in the struggle in the mountains was truly enthusiastic and meaningful. Her transition from the press to the guerrilla ranks – joining the guerrillas with such a level of consciousness – naturally represented an important stance from the guerrillas’ perspective in terms of guerrilla training, organization, and the struggle. I commemorate her with respect and gratitude.


Nagihan Akarsel was also an important journalist. She was a force of thought. As is known, she was assassinated in Sulaymaniyah. The Turkish state bears great guilt in this murder. The Turkish state has murdered many of our comrades, particularly our journalists, with their UCAVs. Many of our comrades working in the media in Sulaymaniyah, the Medya Defense Zones, and in Southern Kurdistan in general have been murdered by the Turkish state’s airstrikes and UCAV attacks. I commemorate all of them with gratitude and respect.


Comrade Nagihan Akarsel was not only a journalist but also made very important contributions to Jineolojî, the science of women’s liberation. She is one of the pioneers of the science of women’s liberation. And Jineolojî is the mother of all sciences. It is the mother of the social sciences. Without understanding the science of women’s liberation, the social sciences cannot be properly understood. The social sciences cannot be properly addressed. And the contributions of Nagihan Akarsel to Jineolojî have truly been immense. I also remember her with gratitude and respect.


Comrade Bêrîtan’s stance is of the utmost importance. She is a symbol of the stance for women’s freedom. Indeed, Rêber Apo defined the character and identity of …

author: Unknown
title: Once again on Kurdish democratic unity
content:
The creation of Kurdish democratic unity continues to be a matter of urgent importance. The stage reached by the Third World War, which is spreading and deepening across the Middle East, makes this an immediate necessity. The process initiated by Abdullah Öcalan’s Call for Peace and Democratic Society on 27 February 2025 has made Kurdish democratic unity an urgent task.


Although some collaborationist-nationalist circles continue to create obstacles, the forces supporting national democratic unity are growing by the day. Kurdish intellectuals and politicians are placing greater emphasis on democratic unity than ever before. Politicians are speaking about democratic unity, while intellectuals are writing about it. There is a demand both for unity and for that unity to be democratic, because the Kurds need both unity and democracy. At present, there is neither sufficient national unity nor sufficient democracy. Yet developments in the region and the struggle in Kurdistan need democratic unity more than bread and water.


The stage reached by the Third World War in the region is creating both significant opportunities for the Kurds and very serious dangers. To seize these opportunities and avert these dangers, the Kurds need to unite and develop their democracy. With Kurdish politics fragmented, lacking unity and democracy, it does not appear possible to seize these opportunities or avert the dangers. Almost everyone now sees and expresses this. More importantly, all of us have a responsibility to fulfil such a task for the success of the Peace and Democratic Society Process initiated and led by Abdullah Öcalan.


The process initiated by the Call for Peace and Democratic Society on 27 February 2025 is clearly pushing both the Kurds and Turkey as a whole, including the state and society, towards change and democratization. The steps taken by the Kurdish Freedom Movement in this direction are prompting everyone to reassess their current position and move towards democratic change and transformation. This is undoubtedly not easy in one respect; it requires greater courage and sacrifice, as well as more courageous criticism and self-criticism. In another respect, it places new and greater responsibilities before everyone, requiring a more organized and creative struggle. The tasks of the new process cannot be accomplished through the fragmented, excessively centralized approaches and structures of the past that placed only one’s own party at the centre. In short, the Peace and Democratic Society Process is compelling all Kurds to create democratic unity.


The approach of the Turkish side, namely the state and the government, to the Peace and Democratic Society Process makes Kurdish democratic unity even more important and urgent. For example, the final statement issued after the National Security Council meeting on 30 September clearly shows that there is nothing new on the Turkish side. In both content and tone, the statement is identical to National Security Council statements from two years ago. Despite a new process having been underway in Turkey for two years, it still refers to the “Kurdistan Workers’ Party (PKK)-Kurdistan Communities Union (KCK) terrorist organization” and places it in the same category as ISIS. Naturally, when the National Security Council uses such language, the special warfare media uses the same language and content. But what will happen if the Kurdish side and Kurdish media also continue to speak of the “fascist Turkish Republic”? The National Security Council statement is entirely anti-Kurdish and makes the elimination of Kurdish gains and Kurdish existence a central political objective. What, then, remains of the discourse of Turkish-Kurdish brotherhood?


The final statement of the National Security Council meeting on 30 September makes it very clear that there has been no change in the anti-Kurdish mentality and policies of the Republic of Turkey. With the state maintaining this position, the Justice and Development Party (AKP) government is also implementing the same mentality and policies on a daily basis. In this context, we should look at what the AKP government is doing. Has there been any democratic change compared with two years ago? Not only is it clear that there has been no such change, but it can even be said that repression and exploitation have increased. Most importantly, there has been no change in the conditions of Abdullah Öcalan. Even the Peoples’ Equality and Democracy …

author: Unknown
title: Çetintepe: Constitutional Court ruling may leave women more helpless
content:
The Constitutional Court annulled on 4 June 2026 the provision in Article 175 of the Turkish Civil Code that allowed a spouse who would fall into poverty as a result of divorce to claim alimony from the other spouse “indefinitely,” finding it unconstitutional. The reasoning for the annulment was published in the Official Gazette on 30 September. The ruling will take effect nine months later, on 30 June 2027.


Gamze Çetintepe of the Women’s Defence Network spoke to ANF about the Constitutional Court’s ruling and drew attention to how the reasoning portrays men who pay alimony as “victims.” Çetintepe said women’s acquired rights were being taken away and women’s labour was being rendered invisible.


Çetintepe said the ruling was based on a narrative suggesting that women were trying to “take away” something that rightfully belonged to men and that this created a grievance for men.


Çetintepe described the ruling as part of propaganda aimed at trapping women in families marked by exploitation and violence, in line with the “Decade of the Family” policies of making divorce more difficult, encouraging marriage and increasing birth rates. She said the reasoning behind the ruling states:“The reasoning states: ‘Due to the contested provision, the obligation to pay poverty alimony may continue until the end of a person’s life, which could prevent that person from remarrying, acquiring property and providing for future children, and therefore the provision imposes a disproportionate restriction on the person’s right to respect for private and family life and their right to property…’


The so-called disproportionate restriction is alimony averaging 2,000 lira a month. If there is to be a debate about alimony, it should be about why it is so inadequate and why it fails to prevent women from falling into poverty after divorce.”


‘Women are forced to give up even their existing rights’


Çetintepe said the reality of how alimony works in practice is very different from the picture presented by the ruling. She said, “Apart from the inadequacy of alimony payments, it is also very common for even these amounts not to be paid, or for men to tell women, ‘If you don’t ask for alimony, I won’t cause trouble and I’ll agree to the divorce,’ forcing women to give up even their existing rights so that they can escape households of exploitation and violence as quickly as possible.”


Çetintepe said that many men also fail to pay child support, the financial contribution paid by the parent who does not have custody to cover expenses such as the child’s care, education, healthcare and housing in proportion to their financial means.


Çetintepe said, “Many men do not even pay the child support they are required to provide for the care of their children, continuing to place the burden of shared responsibilities on women even after the marriage ends. The same concern shown for men’s private lives and their ability to acquire property is not shown when it comes to monitoring whether the alimony women are entitled to receive is actually paid and ensuring that those payments are made.”


‘Men’s “victimhood” is that they can no longer exploit women’


Çetintepe said the law approaches marriage and divorce in a way that disregards women’s unpaid labour and is implemented in a misogynistic manner. She explained the actual purpose of the ruling and its possible impact on divorce rates as follows: “If women are nevertheless divorcing at increasingly higher rates, it may not be accurate to say that this ruling will change that. But that is certainly the intention. What they call men’s victimhood is precisely this: that they can no longer exploit women.


Still, if we consider this ruling together with all the pro-family policies of which it is a part, as well as the country’s deepening poverty and persistent sexism, it could make women feel more helpless about how they would survive on their own if they divorced.”


‘Women are expected to find work while caring for their children alone’


Asked about claims that ending alimony after a certain period would encourage women to enter the workforce, Çetintepe described this discourse as another part of the propaganda portraying men as victims of women. She explained why women fall into poverty after divorce: “It is not because women can live on monthly alimony payments of 2,000 lira that they do not take paid jobs. The reason women fall into poverty after marriage is the exploitation of their paid and …

author: Kalundi Serumaga
title: As Long as You Don’t Say Nothing, You Can Say Anything at All
content:
In Uganda, censorship is a reality, and in fact, a governance necessity. Once those governing us came to the realization that they cannot give the population what it needs, either because they don’t want to, or because they are not able, then they have got to try to stop the conversation about governing. Why permit or encourage talk about something you know is not going to change? Why raise hope?


That becomes step one, the usual result of which is to then see the discourse migrate to creative spaces, where it operates in a much more multi-layered and subliminal way. This requires a different kind of management of that arts scene, as step two.


With political censorship, matters have been very clear for some time now. Vocal activists who say things that those in power find offensive now have a standard playbook against them. They get barred from as many media outlets as they can. In extreme cases, landlords can be persuaded to evict them from their homes and business premises. Media houses themselves can be banned, or their troublesome journalists harassed or dismissed. There have been reports of even the tax authorities being sent after the records of businesses owned by such critics. Social media influencers are brought on board to cast the predictable aspersions.


Social media platforms themselves can be shut down as a whole. During the contentious 2021 general election, there was a shutdown across the board. Up to today, Facebook remains banned. Then there are the abductions.


This is not to say it comes easy. The human is designed to see, reflect and speak. So political censorship has it challenges. Recently, some laws seeking to make digital democracy more punishable were thwarted. But in the end, it gets done. Of late, there has been a steady stream of convictions of simple users of X (formerly Twitter) for making posts critical of important government figures. The longest sentence has been six years for the offence of insulting the president via TikTok.


The arts are a different kind of problem, requiring a different set of tools. Art is nebulous. It defies time and form. The key thing to understand is that there is a difference between freedom of speech, and freedom of expression. The Uganda arts sector has suffered over a two decades of deliberate sabotage in my view, and this is why I argue that arts censorship has thus been historically approached in a structural way.


In terms of practical implementation of immediate measures, the lines between politics, art, media and morality are very blurred. Many personalities wear more than one hat, with prominent journalists also being politicians, musicians being opinion leaders, and politicians becoming entertainers.


So the goal has been to create an entirely plastic and artificial practice of noisy, energetic, colourful, but ultimately very hollow forms of “African” expression.


This is actually the best form of arts censorship; creative voices must be monitored, and then led astray.


The transformation of the singer Bobi Wine into the major opposition politician known as Robert Kyagulanyi was not the origin of this process, but became the occasion for its intensification.


There had been other political musicians, like Ronald Mayinja whose themes had become a source of quiet nervousness among the authorities. Various theories exist as to how he vanished from prominence, amid a flurry of mixed messaging.


The closest analogy I can think of is the analyses I have seen by and about certain pioneers of old-school Hip Hop in the United States, such as Wise Intelligent, KRS-One, Chuck D and others, who say that the art form was hijacked.


Citing examples from original rap groups such as Roc Nation, they argue that the wider American power structure and society became worried about the political impact of rap music due to its articulation of Black political concerns about racism, imperialism, and poverty. 


They say that the strategic response to this was to encourage the emergence of a new kind of Hip Hop practice, which was mainstreamed and made the dominant and more accessible kind. This was done through the manipulation and encouragement of entertainers more concerned with hedonistic themes in the way those in charge of the major recording companies signed up, curated, distributed and marketed them. The result is largely what became known as “Gangsta Rap”. 


They argue that this process was aimed at depoliticizing, or corrupting a valid art form …

author: Ya puso la puerka radio
title: Ya puso la puerka Radio Episodio 33
content:
¡Amigos y enemigos! ¡Amargopunks y no amargopunks!


Presentamos una entrega más de temas de anarquismo, punk y actualidad que nos somete.  Actualidad a la que estamos obligados — Sí o Sí — a pensar, recuérdese que como Zoon politikón que somos y que como todo indica; no podemos escapar como arte de magia (A menos que te entregues a las drogas —cualquiera— y el embrutecimiento para olvidar y escapar de la realidad.  Bueeeenooo. También a nosotros nos gusta el escapismo, ¿A quién no? Pero breve, si no, no se disfruta) a los vaivenes y estertores de la historia.  Si no ¿Para qué chingados estas de punk?  Es más. Es un puto imperativo vital y existencial el enterarte de todo, cuestionarlo, regurgitarlo, vomitarlo, y cambiar desde tu existencia hasta nuestro entorno próximo y lejano.  A ser un agente de cambio.


Los sucesos nos avasallan, pasan las guerras, el hambre, las ideas, los gobernantes, la violencia y con todo esto tenemos que lidiar con nuestras tragedias individuales, con nuestra pesada existencia, importante mencionar que nuestras tragedias vienen en buena medida de las decisiones y acontecimientos que hicieron otros, a los que no les importamos, a los que les importa mas el prestigio y/o el dinero.  Hijosdeputa!  Y ante este alud de acontecimientos nos damos el tiempo de escoger algunos que nos parecen interesantes y pensarlos, ya saben, desde la mirada del anarquismo y el punk.


De qué hablamos.


La patética visita de Angela Davis y Gina Dent en la UNAM


Patética, porque como dice la palabra Patético= pathētikós. = pathos= sentimiento.   Nos provoca o nos mueve a pensarlo urgentemente.  Sugerimos que pueda ser un punto de quiebre del feminismo, un cisma, y nos proyecte a análisis conectados con lo que ha perseguido el anarquismo y el punk desde su génesis: La destrucción de moldes viejos y construir nuevos basados en la libertad del individuo y la sociedad.  Estuvo chido porque mostró en una forma cagadisima de contradicción de lo que trataba el coloquio y la durísima realidad insultante, no sólo en la UNAM, sino en otros ámbitos, como el antipunitivismo.    Nuestra resolución: Patético hastasuputamadreeee. Ja, ja, ja.


Reflexiones sobre la violencia. Así nomás.


Aquí partimos del nombre de nuestra banda de punk —Descripción muy pretenciosa, para dos Weyes que osaron agarrar unos ruidosos instrumentos y “hacer” música— llamada Radikal Violencia. Como individuos pertenecientes al género humano, nos asumimos como cómplices del odio y la violencia…hacia el opresor, obvio.  Incluso aventuramos una brújula moral para toda la banda: “La violencia hacia abajo, ejercerla con alguien más débil que tú, es cobarde.  La violencia horizontal, con tu igual, es estúpida.  La violencia hacia arriba, con el opresor, es necesaria” ¡¡¡¡Ahhhh perrrroooo!!!


Dos antípodas. Luigi Mangione y Charlie Kirk.


“Comenzamos por el final” ¡Vete a la verga Charlie Kirk!     Aquí comparamos estas vidas paralelas, Luigi, Charlie y nosotros, y hablando de violencia este tema se conecta de una manera muy fluida.  Destacamos a Luigi y reflexionamos sobre Charlie. Uno de los tópicos: El esquema político gringo y mundial ya nos rebasó, ya lo hemos dicho, el simple izquierda y derecha se amplía y ahora hasta tenemos unos weyes llamados Groypers, el internet y los memes ya son parte de el escenario. Para complicar más las cosas.


Bares “culturales” El Alicia por decir uno solamente.


Otro tema para pensar el significado de activista, y activista gestor cultural, y activista depositario de ayudas y comodatos, y activista cantinero. Se desdibuja el significado y las palabras y la semántica sí que importa.   La neta el tema del Alicia ya está muy masticado, pero conviene aterrizar las ideas.


Israhell. El David triunfante y pernicioso desde tiempo bíblicos.


¡Mierda!  Por culpa de estos pendejos y sus aliados, la gente de todo el mundo lo está pasando mal.  Sube el petróleo, el comercio se ralentiza y la gente de a pie en todo el mundo paga los platos rotos.  Sabemos que no estamos descubriendo el agua tibia.  Pero es que si nos da un chingo de dolor de panza del coraje.


Inteligencia Artificial,


La I.A. llegó para quedarse, aunque no lo queramos. Es la batalla tecnológica que se está desarrollando en estos momentos.  Conviene ir agarrando el hilo, aunque no seamos usuarios ni tengamos nuestra ingeniería en Machine Learning.   Hay mucho ruido. Revisamos la noticia de que hay un 10% de probabilidad de que la I.A. destruya la humanidad …

author: Unknown
title: Küçükçekmece'de eğlence mekanında silahlı saldırı: 1'i polis, 2 kişi hayatını kaybetti
content:
İstanbul - Küçükçekmece'de bir eğlence mekanında silahlı saldırı yaşandı. Çıkan çatışmada 1’i polis, 2 kişi hayatını kaybetti, 2 kişi de yaralandı.

DHA'da yer alan habere göre silahlı saldırı, Atatürk Mahallesi İkitelli Caddesi’nde saat 03.40 sularında meydana geldi. Müzikhole gelen bir kişi henüz bilinmeyen nedenle çevreye ateş açtı. Bu sırada içeride olan ve izinli olduğu öğrenilen polis, ateş açan kişiye karşılık verdi. Çıkan çatışmada polis ile ateş açan kişi ağır yaralandı. Çalışanların ihbarı üzerine olay yerine ekipler sevk edildi. Sağlık ekiplerinin yaptığı kontrolde polis ile saldırganın hayatını kaybettiği belirlendi. Çatışmada 2 kişinin de yaralandığı öğrenildi.

İş yerine ait güvenlik kamera görüntülerini inceleyen ekipler, çalışanların da bilgisine başvurdu. İncelemelerin ardından hayatını kaybeden polis ile saldırganın cansız bedeni Adli Tıp Kurumu morguna kaldırıldı.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Unknown
title: CHP’de butlan yönetiminin işçi kıyımı sürüyor: 3 çalışanın daha işine son verildi
content:
CHP’de mahkemenin mutlak butlan kararıyla göreve gelen yönetimin 85’i aşkın genel merkez çalışanını işten çıkarmasının ardından 3 kişinin daha işine son verildi. İşten çıkarılanların eşlerinin daha önce CHP’de çalıştığı, ardından Yeni Parti’de işe başladığı öğrenildi.

CHP’de Kemal Kılıçdaroğlu’nun mahkemenin mutlak butlan kararıyla yeniden genel başkanlık görevine gelmesinin ardından başlayan işten çıkarmalar devam ediyor. Genel merkezde çalışan 85’i aşkın kişinin işine son veren yönetimin, son olarak eşleri Yeni Parti’de çalışmaya başlayan 3 çalışanı daha işten çıkardığı belirtildi.

Cumhuriyet’in haberine göre, işine son verilen Hasan Demirhan’ın eşi Yeni Parti’de büro personeli, Ozan Çiftçi’nin eşi kat görevlisi, Simge Cansu’nun nişanlısı ise büro personeli olarak çalışıyor. Söz konusu kişilerin daha önce CHP’de görev yaptığı, işten çıkarılmalarının ardından Yeni Parti’de işe başladıkları öğrenildi.

CHP’nin 7. Genel Başkanı Kemal Kılıçdaroğlu, 21 Mayıs’ta mahkemenin mutlak butlan kararıyla yeniden genel başkanlık görevine gelmişti. Kararın ardından genel merkez çalışanlarına yönelik işten çıkarmalar 26 Mayıs’ta, Kurban Bayramı arifesinde başlamıştı. İşine son verilen 85’i aşkın çalışan arasında sekreterler, fotoğrafçılar, kameramanlar, temizlik görevlileri ve çay ocağı emekçileri de bulunuyordu.

İşten çıkarmaların bir bölümünde, SGK’ye yapılan bildirimlerde Kod-48'in kullanıldığı belirtilmişti. İşçinin devamsızlığı, işverene veya ailesine yönelik hakaret gibi gerekçelerle iş sözleşmesinin feshedilmesinde kullanılan bu kod nedeniyle çalışanlar kıdem ve ihbar tazminatları ile işsizlik ödeneğinden yararlanamadı. İşten çıkarılan bazı çalışanlar, haklarını aramak için CHP yönetimine karşı dava açmıştı.

author: Unknown
title: 10. Çanakkale Bienali 10 Ekim’de başlıyor: 9 ülkeden 60’tan fazla sanatçı
content:
Gözde Tüzer Korkmaz [email protected]

“Metcezir // Ebb & Flow” başlığıyla düzenlenen 10. Çanakkale Bienali, 10 Ekim-20 Kasım 2026 tarihleri arasında gerçekleştirilecek. Bienalin sergi ve etkinlikleri Çanakkale kent merkezinin yanı sıra Troya, Ayvacık, Assos ve Küçükkuyu’daki 15 farklı mekâna yayılacak.

2006 yılında başlayan ve ilk edisyonunu 2008’de gerçekleştiren Çanakkale Bienali, 10. edisyonunda 9 ülkeden 60’tan fazla sanatçının çalışmalarını bir araya getirecek.

Bienalin bu yılki programı “Metcezir // Ebb & Flow” başlığı altında suyun çekilmesi ve yükselmesinden hareketle hafıza, coğrafya ve zamanın dönüşümünü ele alıyor. Su, toprak, hafıza ve dönüşüm kavramları etrafında şekillenen programda yeni üretimlerin yanı sıra farklı disiplinlerden çalışmalar ve uluslararası iş birlikleri yer alacak.

Bienal kapsamında Çanakkale’nin tarihî yapılarının yanı sıra gündelik yaşamın parçası olan farklı mekânlar da sanat çalışmalarına ev sahipliği yapacak.

Eski palamut depoları bölgesindeki MAHAL, StudioMAHAL ve DemirHAN, Troia Vakfı Korfmann Kütüphanesi ve Troya Müzesi bienalin ana mekânları arasında bulunuyor.

Çarşı içindeki Mavi Ev de programda yer alırken, Cuma Pazarı'nın yanındaki bir park kalıcı bir kamusal sanat çalışmasına ev sahipliği yapacak. Yeni kuşak sanatçı ve tasarımcıların çalışmalarını sürdürdüğü sanayi bölgesindeki ASTİM de bienal kapsamında kullanılacak.

Çanakkale’nin denizle ilişkisine odaklanan özel seçkinin adresi ise Balıkhane olacak.

Program kent merkeziyle sınırlı kalmayacak. Ayvacık’ın Yukarı Tartışık Köyü, Küçükkuyu’daki Adatepe Zeytinyağı Müzesi, Assos’taki Güneşane Vakfı ve İda Blue Adatepe de bienal kapsamındaki mekânlar arasında yer alacak.

Çanakkale Bienali programında Çanakkale’nin seramik mirasına odaklanan “Özel Odak: Seramik” seçkisi de yer alıyor.

Seramiği yalnızca bir üretim tekniği olarak değil, hafıza, arkeoloji, tarih, coğrafya ve dönüşümle ilişkili bir malzeme olarak ele alan seçkide farklı kuşaklardan sanatçıların çalışmaları bir araya getirilecek.

Troya Müzesi başta olmak üzere MAHAL, Korfmann Kütüphanesi ve Mavi Ev’de gösterilecek çalışmalar, Çanakkale’nin tarihsel üretim geleneği ile çağdaş sanat pratikleri arasındaki ilişkiye odaklanacak.

Bienal, Çanakkale’deki kurumların yanı sıra uluslararası kültür kurumlarının destekleriyle gerçekleştiriliyor.

Dardanel ile Kale Grubu-Kale Tasarım ve Sanat Merkezi’nin ana destekçiliğini üstlendiği bienal, Çanakkale İl Kültür ve Turizm Müdürlüğü, Çanakkale Onsekiz Mart Üniversitesi ve Çanakkale Belediyesi iş birliğiyle düzenleniyor. Troya Kazı Başkanlığı, ÇATKAV ve Troia Vakfı yerel paydaşlar arasında yer alırken, 1915 Çanakkale Köprüsü ve Otoyolu da kurumsal destekçiler arasında bulunuyor.

“Metcezir // Ebb & Flow” başlıklı 10. Çanakkale Bienali, 10 Ekim’de başlayacak ve 20 Kasım’a kadar devam edecek.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

title: Эррико Малатеста - Антимилитаризм: был ли он правильно понят?
content:

Дорогой товарищ, – Позволь мне сказать несколько слов о статье Кропоткина об антимилитаризме, опубликованной в вашем последнем номере. По моему мнению, антимилитаризм – это доктрина, утверждающая, что военная служба есть отвратительное и убийственное ремесло, и что человек никогда не должен соглашаться брать оружие по приказу господ и никогда не должен воевать иначе как за Социальную Революцию.

Разве это - неправильное понимание антимилитаризма?

Кропоткин, похоже, забыл об антагонизме классов, о необходимости экономического освобождения и обо всём анархистском учении; и говорит, что антимилитарист всегда должен быть готов, в случае если разразится война, взяться за оружие в поддержку «страны, которая подвергнется нападению»; что, учитывая невозможность – по крайней мере, для рядового рабочего – своевременно установить, кто истинный агрессор, на практике означает, что «антимилитарист» Кропоткина всегда должен подчиняться приказам своего правительства. Что остаётся после этого от антимилитаризма и, в самом деле, даже от самого анархизма?

Фактически Кропоткин отказывается от антимилитаризма, потому что думает, что национальные вопросы должны быть решены прежде социального вопроса. Для нас национальные соперничества и ненависть относятся к числу лучших средств, которыми располагают господа для увековечения рабства рабочих, и мы должны противостоять им всеми нашими силами. Что же касается права малых национальностей сохранять, если они того пожелают, свой язык и свои обычаи, – это просто вопрос свободы, и он найдёт реальное и окончательное решение только тогда, когда, после разрушения государств, каждая человеческая группа, более того, каждый индивид получит право объединяться с любой другой группой и отделяться от неё.

Мне очень больно выступать против такого старого и любимого друга, как Кропоткин, который сделал так много для дела анархизма. Но именно по той причине, что Кропоткин столь ценим и любим всеми нами, необходимо дать знать, что мы не следуем за ним в его высказываниях о войне.

Я знаю, что эта позиция Кропоткина не вполне нова и что более десяти лет он проповедовал против «немецкой угрозы»; и признаюсь, что мы были неправы, не придав значения его франко-русскому патриотизму и не предвидя, куда приведут его антинемецкие предрассудки. Это потому, что мы понимали: он намеревался призвать французских рабочих ответить на возможное немецкое вторжение, совершив Социальную Революцию, – то есть взяв в свои руки французскую землю и пытаясь побудить немецких рабочих брататься с ними в борьбе против французских и немецких угнетателей. Разумеется, мы никогда не могли бы вообразить, что Кропоткин призовёт рабочих к единению с правительствами и хозяевами.

Надеюсь, что он увидит свою ошибку и встанет снова на сторону рабочих против всех правительств и всех буржуа: немцев, англичан, французов, русских, бельгийцев и так далее.

author: Unknown
title: Ephéméride des luttes : 8 octobre
content:
Le 8 octobre, l'éphéméride des luttes est profondément antimilitariste, mais elle n'est en rien pacifique. Elle sait que glisser une fleur dans le canon d'un fusil ne l'empêche pas de tirer. Alors elle s'organise contre les structures de la guerre et du fascisme.


1901 :

 A Barcelone, l'anarchiste Francisco Ferrer ouvre "l'école moderne", dans le but d'offrir une éducation libre et sans dogmes.


1936 :

 En Espagne, mort d'Emile Cottin, membre du bataillon international de la Colonne Durruti lors de combats contre les fascistes de Franco.


1963 :

 Mort à Mexico de la peintre surréaliste anarchiste Remedios Varo. Une de ses peintures illustre l'éphéméride d'aujourd'hui.


1967 :

 En Bolivie, Ernesto Che Guevara est capturé puis assassiné par l'armée bolivienne (soutenue par la CIA) alors qu'il tente de lancer un mouvement de guérilla de libération dans le pays. Roberto Quintanilla, considéré comme étant l'un des principaux responsables de cette mort, sera abattu à Hambourg le 1er avril 1971 par la révolutionnaire Monika Ertl alors qu'il occupe la fonction de consul de Bolivie.


1968 :

 La faction Weatherman du SDS (qui passera dans la clandestinité et la lutte armée deux ans plus tard) organise les 'Jours de Rage' dans les rues de Chicago, contre la guerre du Vietnam et l'impérialisme américain, avec pour but de créer le plus de dégâts possibles dans les quartiers bourgeois. Le mot d'ordre : "

Bring the War Home

".


1975 :

 A Paris, les Brigades Internationales commando Juan Paredes Manot (du nom d'un militant d'ETA fusillé quelques jours plus tôt avec deux autres membres d'ETA et deux membres du FRAP) touchent de plusieurs balles Garcia Plata, attaché militaire de l'ambassade de Franco.


1977 :

 - A Paris, les NAPAP (Noyaux Armés Pour l'Autonomie Populaire) commettent un attentat contre le domicile du garde des Sceaux de l'époque Alain Peyrefitte rue du Ranelagh.


 En Irlande du Nord, l'IRA abat une officière de l'Ulster Defence Regiment.


1984 :

 A Evere (Bruxelles), les Cellules Communistes Combattantes (CCC) font sauter le QG de l'entreprise d'informatique et électronique Honeywell, qui participe au programme de construction des missiles. C'est notamment un ordinateur Honeywell qui coordonnait les attaques au Vietnam en 1972 (que la Fraction Armée Rouge fait sauter le

24 mai

 72). L'entreprise avait aussi déjà été attaquée attaquée le 8 avril 1980 à Toulouse par le CLODO (Comité pour la Liquidation ou la Destruction des Ordinateurs), le 20 novembre 1983 à Düsseldorf par les Cellules Révolutionnaires (RZ) et le 14 décembre 1983 par l'United Freedom Front (UFF) à New York. Lire le

communiqué de revendication

.


1985 :

 A Bruxelles, les Cellules Communistes Combattantes (CCC) font sauter une camionnette piégée devant le siège principal du trust de l'énergie INTERCOM, début de leur 'campagne Karl Marx'. Le communiqué de l'action peut être lu

à cette adresse

.


2016 :

 - A

Marseille

,

plus de 300 antifascistes manifestent

 contre la présence de l'Action Française, un groupuscule royaliste, dans le quartier. Le cortège est attaqué par la police (massivement présente pour défendre les fachos) et quelques personnes sont blessés rue des Bons Enfants par des coups de matraque et une grenade, mais celui-ci se poursuit jusqu'à revenir sur la Plaine.


 A Notre-Dame-Des-Landes, plus de 40000 personnes manifestent pour répondre à l'appel de défense de la ZAD contre les menaces d'expulsion par le gouvernement.

 A Montpellier, des conteneurs à poubelle

sont incendiés

 devant le local du Parti Socialiste avec l'inscription "Fini de trahir".


Voir

l'éphéméride anarchiste

 du 8 octobre.

content:

Получаем из Генуи письмо, которое доказывает ещё раз, что экономическая борьба, если она не вдохновлена высоким идеалом человеческой солидарности и остаётся замкнутой в пределах текущих и непосредственных интересов рабочих, не только не может вести к окончательному освобождению, но, напротив, стремится создавать антагонизмы и борьбу между одними рабочими и другими рабочими – к полной выгоде сохранения буржуазного порядка.

Это генуэзские телеграфные рассыльные, которые требуют исключения женщин из контор по доставке. Они протестуют против того, что «в конторах держат столько барышень, которые работают только для того, чтобы покупать себе духи, пудру, шёлковые чулочки, тогда как столько тысяч демобилизованных, после того как сражались за благо и величие бумажников их господ, видят себя отвергнутыми от того места, которое было бы им необходимо, чтобы накормить своих детей». И в статье подписанной «Персонал рассыльных и третья категория почтово-телеграфных работников» говорят:

Причина? Прежде всего, женщины в управлениях не все рассыльные. Есть много других категорий женщин на службе, (гораздо выше) и которые к слову «пролетариат» питают священный ужас, и в агитациях всегда были теми, кто предавал дело или серьёзно компрометировал окончательный исход: почтово-телеграфным и банковским работникам слово. Следует учесть, что женщины в конторах не представляют никакой активной единицы, а напротив – элемент постоянного раздора, с разным обращением с тем и другим полом. Пусть будет проведён плебисцит среди всех тех, кто осуждён работать с женским элементом, и Avanti![1] убедится, что и среди социалистов существует в высшей степени оправданная неприязнь к этой рабочей силе, которая не что иное, как конкуренция мужчине, и элемент, легчайше поддающийся дезертирству, и потому используемый для противовеса движениям, которые могут происходить в рабочем классе.

Служащая никогда не сможет быть хорошей матерью семейства: либо одно, либо другое; нельзя быть на двух местах.

Следует иметь в виду, что женщина в силу своих особых физических условий не может быть привлечена к тяжёлым, ночным работам или работам с большой ответственностью (телеграф, железные дороги и так далее). Отсюда дурное настроение другой стороны, вынужденной служить затычкой и восполнять недостатки этого персонала.

Итак, домой женщин – лучше воспитывать своих детей, а на их место поставить всю ту безработную молодёжь, которую ежедневно отвергают. Почему предпочитают сестру брату!

Это и есть прям-таки всё рыцарство?! Это социалистический идеал? Нет! мы не верим в это, потому что женщина укореняется именно в крупных буржуазных учреждениях и в государственных конторах, где её держат как материал для противопоставления нашим священным требованиям, и не только поэтому, но прежде всего потому, что у неё более приятная улыбка и более сговорчивый нрав, чем у мужского пола.

Не будем говорить об отдаче, которую они могут дать: они чаще всего больны из-за тех естественных недомоганий, которым подвержены женщины, особенно когда они беременны и не показываются больше шести месяцев».

Оставив в стороне соображения физиологического и социального порядка о производительности и социальной миссии женщины, которые привели бы нас к дискуссии, не умещающейся в этой статье, – кто мог бы упрекнуть людей, которые голодны, которые видят, как чахнут их дети, и единственная надежда которых найти работу – это заставить выгнать другого с занимаемого им места, если они сравнивают с завистью и яростью своё положение несчастного с положением более удачливых рабочих (или работниц) и стараются, хотя бы и с аргументами, которые служат хозяевам, заставить отправить их вон с целью заменить их?

Но тогда не правы и те злополучные, которые по той или иной причине никогда …

author: cnt.es
title: 14 de octubre. Inauguración de la exposición ‘Una brecha en el silencio: exhumaciones en el cementerio parroquial de Colmenar Viejo’
content:
El miércoles,

14 de octubre

, a las

19:00

, se inaugurará en nuestra sede de la FAL en Madrid la exposición fotográfica

Una brecha en el silencio: exhumaciones en el cementerio parroquial de Colmenar Viejo

, con la cual descubriremos el exhaustivo trabajo de recuperación de las víctimas de la violencia franquista en el cementerio parroquial de Colmenar Viejo.


El mismo

14 de octubre

, coincidiendo con la inauguración, se celebrarán dos conferencias. La primera correrá a cargo del antropólogo

Roberto Fernández Suáre

z, bajo el título

Represión franquista en el Norte de Madrid

. Posteriormente participará

Carmen Carreras Béjar

, secretaria de la ACVSSR, con la charla

Las exhumaciones en el cementerio parroquial de Colmenar Viejo: inicio, gestiones y desarrollo del proyecto

.


El día

21 de octubre

, a las 19:00, se realizará la conferencia

Exhumaciones en el cementerio parroquial de Colmenar Viejo: resultados y estado del proyecto

, a cargo de

Elvira García Aragón

, perteneciente a Equipo A de Arqueología.


A través de sus

fotografías

, conoceremos los trabajos arqueológicos que permitieron localizar a

77 de las 90 personas desaparecidas

, así como una selección de objetos personales recuperados junto a las víctimas, debidamente restaurados.


Os dejamos con la información detallada de la exposición:


El

1 de abril de 1939

 se dio por finalizada la Guerra Civil y quince días después se producía el primer fusilamiento en las tapias del cementerio parroquial de

Col-menar Viejo,

 el de

Isidoro Marivela Paredes,

 último alcalde republicano de Colmenar Viejo junto a otros tres hombres. El siguiente fusilamiento masivo tendría lugar el 9 de mayo. En los seis meses siguientes los fusilamientos se repitieron hasta matar a un total de

108 personas.


Colmenar Viejo, como cabeza de partido judicial, fue elegida como sede del tribunal militar que iba a ocuparse de Juzgar a aquellos republicanos y republicanas de todas las localidades pertenecientes a su partido judicial, desde Miraflores de la Sierra al norte hasta Hortaleza (población aún no integrada en la ciudad de Madrid) al sur del mismo.


El proyecto técnico-científico para la recuperación de las víctimas de la violencia franquista del cementerio parroquial de Colmenar Viejo ha sido elaborado por la Sociedad de Ciencias Aranzadi y lo lleva a cabo en colaboración con la Asociación Cultural Equipo A de Arqueología, la Unidad de Antropología Física de la Facultad de Biología de la Universidad Complutense de Madrid y los laboratorios de genética BIOMICs de la Universidad del País Vasco y CITOGEN.


En agosto de 2022 se realizó la primera excavación en la mitad Sureste del antiguo cementerio civil. Fueron localizadas tres zanjas o trincheras en las que estaban dispuestos los cuerpos de 12 de las víctimas buscadas. Se trataba de individuos de sexo biológico masculino, que presentaban traumatismos compatibles con heridas por arma de fuego, principalmente en cráneo y mandíbula. La mayoría estaban enterrados en ataúd, dispuestos hasta en tres niveles. En julio de 2023 se retomaron los trabajos en el cementerio civil, pero no se documentó la presencia de nuevas fosas ni enterramientos relacionados con la represión.


Las exhumaciones realizadas en el cementerio parroquial de Colmenar Viejo se llevaron a cabo a petición de los familiares de las víctimas con el objetivo de identificar los restos y proporcionarles una sepultura digna. El proceso de identificación combina el análisis de testimonios y fuentes documentales con los datos obtenidos mediante excavación arqueológica, estudio antropológico y análisis genético. En la antigua zona civil se localizaron al menos 12 víctimas enterradas en distintos momentos, todas ellas adultos de sexo biológico masculino con evidencias de muerte violenta por arma de fuego. Entre los restos hallados se identificó a Florencio Elipe Sánchez gracias a una amputación previa del brazo documentada históricamente y confirmada por análisis genético. En la gran fosa del espacio conocido como «el paseo» se documentaron 65 inhumaciones, entre ellas los restos de Mar-tina Aparicio Bastero, la única mujer identificada. El acto de entrega de restos a las familias que tuvo lugar en la Universidad Complutense en septiembre de 2024, representó un paso clave en el camino hacia la Verdad y la Reparación.


En «el paseo», sin embargo, fueron sucediéndose los hallazgos a lo largo de sus 47m de longitud y 1,5m de anchura. Se trataba …

title: 23 de octubre. De afiliada a participante: hacer sindicalismo en lo público
content:
¿Estás afiliada a CNT pero no sabes muy bien por dónde empezar?


¿Trabajas en una administración pública, un ayuntamiento, la sanidad, la educación o cualquier otro servicio público y te gustaría organizarte con tus compañeras?


Ven a conocer una experiencia concreta de organización sindical en lo público, compartir preguntas y pensar juntas cómo pasar de la afiliación a la participación.


Viernes, 23 de octubre de 2026

, a las

18:30 h


Local de CNT en Bilbao

. María Muñoz, 10, 1.º .Metro:

Zazpikaleak

, salida

Unamuno


Para apuntarse:


sindical@bilbao.cnt.es


Afiliarse es un primer paso. Pero, ¿qué viene después?


En los centros de trabajo muchas veces sabemos que existen problemas —condiciones laborales, organización del trabajo, falta de personal, abusos, arbitrariedades, sobrecarga, conflictos con la dirección…—, pero no siempre sabemos cómo convertir esas situaciones en organización colectiva. Tampoco es evidente qué puede hacer una persona afiliada, cómo funciona una sección sindical, cómo se toman las decisiones o cómo se empieza a intervenir en un centro de trabajo.


Por eso organizamos

«De afiliada a participante: hacer sindicalismo en lo público»

, una sesión para conocer de cerca una experiencia concreta de organización sindical en la Administración Pública.


Nos acompañarán compañeras de la

sección sindical de CNT en la Xunta de Galiza

, una sección con alrededor de

500 personas afiliadas

 y presencia en ámbitos muy diversos de la Administración: administración general, sanidad, educación, bomberos y otros colectivos de los servicios públicos.


Más que una exposición teórica sobre sindicalismo, la propuesta es conocer

cómo se construye una sección sindical en el día a día

.


¿Cómo empezaron? ¿Qué problemas se encontraron? ¿Cómo consiguieron que más compañeras se implicaran? ¿Cómo se organiza una sección con cientos de afiliadas y trabajadoras de sectores y centros diferentes? ¿Qué tareas hace concretamente cada persona que participa en ella? ¿Cómo se decide qué conflictos abordar? ¿Qué herramientas utilizan? ¿Qué les ha funcionado y qué no?


También hablaremos de algo especialmente importante:

el paso de la afiliación individual a la participación colectiva

.


Porque una sección sindical no se construye únicamente con quienes tienen experiencia previa, ocupan cargos o conocen a fondo la legislación laboral. Una sección necesita personas que participen de maneras muy diferentes: informando a sus compañeras, detectando problemas, asistiendo a una reunión, ayudando a preparar una acción, difundiendo información, acompañando a otra trabajadora ante un conflicto o, simplemente, empezando a plantearse qué se puede hacer colectivamente allí donde trabaja.


La Administración Pública tiene sus particularidades como espacio laboral. El patrón no es una empresa privada, sino una administración que adopta decisiones a través de estructuras jerárquicas, procedimientos administrativos y normas específicas. Además, nos encontramos con plantillas grandes y diversas, diferentes cuerpos y categorías, personal funcionario y laboral, temporalidad, servicios externalizados y realidades muy distintas según el centro de trabajo.


Pero esas particularidades

no eliminan la necesidad de organización sindical

. Al contrario: hacen especialmente importante conocer qué posibilidades tenemos para organizarnos y actuar colectivamente.


Durante la sesión podremos preguntar directamente a las compañeras de la Xunta de Galiza por su experiencia y conocer tanto sus aciertos como sus dificultades. La idea no es presentar un modelo cerrado que haya que reproducir exactamente en otros centros de trabajo, sino

compartir herramientas, experiencias y aprendizajes que puedan servirnos para pensar nuestra propia organización

.


¿A quién va dirigida?


A cualquier persona afiliada a CNT que trabaje en el sector público y quiera empezar a participar más activamente en la organización sindical, independientemente de su experiencia previa. También a trabajadoras del sector público que estén pensando en afiliarse.


También a quienes ya participan en una sección sindical y quieren conocer otras experiencias, contrastar formas de trabajo y encontrar nuevas herramientas.


No hace falta tener experiencia sindical previa.

 No hace falta saber de legislación laboral, haber participado en elecciones sindicales ni ocupar ningún tipo de representación. Tampoco hace falta tener claro qué quieres hacer.

author: Pip Hinman
title: High Court’s landmark climate ruling counts true cost of coal
content:
The High Court of Australia ruled on October 7 that the New South Wales Independent Planning Commission (IPC) must consider how the burning of fossil fuels, exported from this country, contributed to climate damage.

It upheld an earlier unanimous NSW Court of Appeal ruling that the expansion approval of MACH Energy’s open-cut thermal coal at Mount Pleasant was invalid.

The Denman Aberdeen Muswellbrook Scone Healthy Environment Group (DAMS HEG), from the Upper Hunter Valley, had battled for four years over the coal mine’s expansion.

Climate activists believe this is a landmark judgement. Judging from the negative responses from One Nation and NSW Labor, that would seem to be the case. Prime Minister Anthony Albanese also weighed in on the side of MACH Energy in May, telling 2HD Newcastle Radio that he supported the expansion.

The campaign group, motivated by broader notions around climate justice, is also concerned about the transition for those working in the coal industry. Tony Lonergan, from DAMS HEG told a media conference on October 7 that NSW Labor had failed to put in place, and properly fund, a fair transition plan for affected communities.

Wendy Wales, president of DAMS HEG, said: “Today the High Court has said what we have always known: We cannot dig up coal, ship it overseas, watch it drive climate change and then pretend the consequences have nothing to do with us and won’t be felt by us.

“The droughts, the bushfires, the floods — are directly connected to greenhouse gases, and massive fossil fuel projects like Mt Pleasant Optimisation simply add fuel to the fire.”

Wales and Lonergan, both retired science teachers, live on a farm in the Upper Hunter Valley adjacent to the Mount Pleasant mine.

The Hunter Valley community group has been fighting MACH Energy’s expansion plan — to double Mount Pleasant’s output to 21 million tonnes a year and extend operations until 2048.

The community group initially lost its challenge last year in the NSW Land and Environment Court, after the IPC approved the 22-year expansion. It then successfully appealed that decision, prompting Mach Energy to take the case to the High Court.

The High Court dismissed MACH Energy’s appeal, saying the IPC had not considered how pollution from its coal would affect the region, through increased bushfire risk, drought, flooding and extreme heat. MACH Energy argued that Scope 3 emissions (emissions produced from burning the exported coal) from its mine should be considered through Australia’s pre-existing obligations under the Paris Agreement.

Three of the five judges found that the NSW IPC needed to “consider imposing conditions to minimise to the greatest extent practicable all greenhouse gas emissions, including Scope 3 emissions”.

The judgement means that the Mount Pleasant coal mine expansion approval to 2048 is invalid. But MACH Energy was given approval, in August, to operate until 2032. It had sought to double the output to 21 million tonnes a year.

Wales said the court decision “has finally made a change in direction in our laws. The [planning rules] will now have to reflect the need to consider climate impacts of our scope three emissions from the coal that we export.”

Lonergan said: “This ruling is in line with the International Court of Justice ruling [in July 2025] that said countries that use fossil fuels are responsible for the mitigation of emissions.

“We cannot just say, ‘Well, 98% of emissions comes from the burning of the coal overseas — that’s somebody else’s problem. Nothing to do with us!’ That’s just not going to work any more.”

Nic Clyde, coordinator of Lock the Gate Alliance NSW, said the ruling would affect 17 coal projects currently in the state’s planning pipeline. “Today’s decision sends a strong message to the planning system: the price households and communities are paying for coal pollution must be weighed properly in the planning system,” he said. “It’s no longer okay to ignore the climate cost of coal revenues.”

“The upper hunter economy needed to be diversified away from coal mining,” Lonergan said. “The area is completely dependent on coal mining, and everyone is pretending that we are just going to carry on.

“There’s the Future Jobs and Investment Fund which has stalled in the Upper House because the Labor Party won’t pass legislation to assist in the transition of the economy, diversify the economy.

“This landmark case shows that governments have to start getting serious about emissions …

author: Kodao Productions
title: Leandro Leviste’s arrest order explained
content:
A local court ordered the arrest of one of the country’s youngest and richest legislators over alleged alleged failures to put up solar energy farms in accordance with a congressional franchise awarded in 2019.


Makati City Regional Trial Court Branch 235 issued a warrant of arrest against Batangas Rep. Leandro Leviste on Monday, October 5, for allegedly violating the country’s Public Service Act (PSA). The warrant set Leviste’s bail at P72,000.


Leviste, however, is in Europe in an extended and unexplained absence from his duties as a member of the House of Representatives .


What is Leviste accused of?


Leviste is the founder of the Solar Para sa Bayan (Solar for the People) Corporation, granted a 25-year franchise to construct, install, establish, operate, and maintain solar-powered generation facilities and mini-grid systems in the Philippines. His company promised to supply affordable, reliable, and sustainable electricity to underserved areas in the Philippines.


The company, however, failed to deliver, resulting in cancelled service contracts and billions of pesos in government penalties, the Department of Energy (DOE) reported.


Leviste however succeeded in raising more capital by going public with a derivative company, the Solar Philippines Nueva Ecija Corp. that was valued at P60.9 billion (Dh3.57 billion) at the time of its initial public offering in December 2021.


He subsequently divested large blocks of shares to Meralco PowerGen Corporation (MGen) and other investors, earning over P34 billion in the process.


Government regulators said Leviste violated his congressional franchise by not seeking permission before selling parts of his operations to other entities. Leviste’s firm was subsequently slapped with a P24 billion fine.


Who is Leviste?


The 33-year old first-term legislator is a son of incumbent senator Loren Legarda and former Batangas provincial governor Antonio Leviste.


The younger Leviste came into national political consciousness when he publicly criticized former allies of past Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte who jumped ship and allied themselves with the ruling Ferdinand Marcos Jr. clique after the Marcos-Duterte fallout in 2024.


His troubles escalated when Marcos’ Executive Secretary Ralph Recto publicly accused him of attempting to offer large-scale payoffs (allegedly ranging from P400 million to P1 billion) to influence political outcomes in Batangas. Recto, himself from Batangas Province, is a political rival of the Levistes.


Leviste left the Philippines in August, purportedly to accompany his mother Legarda in seeking medical treatment abroad. Legarda’s medical leave with the Philippine Senate had been extended six times.


Does Leviste deserve arrest?


Leviste’s lawyer Antonio La Viña said Leviste’s arrest warrant was based on “a complaint looking for a crime.”


La Viña said Leviste did not implement the franchise because the DOE did not issue the necessary rules and regulations. The agency did not identify the places where the franchise could be implemented.


“[Y]ou cannot invoke a general penal clause of a law without identifying specific provisions in the law which an accused has committed. In other words, ‘no harm, no foul,’ the lawyer added.


Leviste belittled the arrest order, saying it is “a small matter compared to the other things happening.”


“I am more concerned about you,” he added.


Center of the crisis


As two of the rapidly dwindling Duterte allies in the Philippine legislature, the mother-son’s legal troubles are only expected to worsen.


Last Sunday, Philippine Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla announced the impending filing of about 20 graft and corruption charges against Leviste and Legarda.


Legarda is a member of the Senate minority allied with Vice President Sara Duterte who is undergoing an impeachment trial. Two of her colleagues are in jail for plunder while another is in hiding from an International Criminal Court arrest order.


In a heated debate two weeks ago, the Senate decided that only those who are physically present during the trial promulgation may vote whether to absolve or to oust the Philippine vice president from office.


Duterte’s public threats to have Marcos assassinated and the ongoing trial to oust the vice president are described as one of the worst political crises in the Philippines in the century. #

(Raymund B. Villanueva)

author: Unknown
title: YTÜ’de veri ihlali: Öğrencilerin kişisel verileri güvende mi?
content:
Yıldız Teknik Üniversitesinde (YTÜ) 1 Ekim’den bu yana yaşanan sistem sorunlarının arkasından siber saldırı çıktı. Kişisel Verileri Koruma Kurulunun (KVKK) 7 Ekim tarihli kararıyla üniversitedeki veri ihlali kamuoyuna duyuruldu. İhlalden yaklaşık 140 bin öğrenci ile 4 bin 500 personelin etkilenmiş olabileceği belirtildi.

KVKK’nin duyurusuna göre YTÜ’nün sanallaştırma altyapısı ve bu altyapı üzerinde çalışan sunucular fidye yazılımı saldırısından etkilendi. İhlalin 1 Ekim’de başladığı ve aynı gün tespit edildiği belirtilirken, hangi kişisel verilerin etkilendiğinin henüz belirlenemediği açıklandı.

Üniversitenin internet sitesi, Öğrenci Bilgi Sistemi (OBS), Online Yıldız ve çeşitli başvuru sistemlerine erişim günlerce sağlanamazken, üniversite yönetimi yaşananların nedenine ilişkin öğrencilere açık ve kapsamlı bir bilgilendirme yapmadı. Yönetim 3 Ekim’de yaptığı açıklamada yaşananları yalnızca “teknik çalışma” olarak duyurdu.

KVKK’nin kararıyla birlikte sistemlerde yaşanan kesintilerin bir siber saldırı sonucu gerçekleştiği ortaya çıkarken, öğrencilerin hangi verilerinin ihlalden etkilendiği ise hâlâ belirsiz.

Öğrencilerin kişisel verilerinin güvenliği konusunda üniversite yönetiminin ne tür önlemler aldığı ve ihlalin kapsamının ne olduğu soruları cevapsız kalıyor.

KVKK’nın duyurusunda şu ifadelere yer verildi:

“Kamuoyu Duyurusu (Veri İhlali Bildirimi) – Yıldız Teknik Üniversitesi

Bilindiği üzere, 6698 sayılı Kişisel Verilerin Korunması Kanununun ‘Veri güvenliğine ilişkin yükümlülükler” başlıklı 12 nci maddesinin (5) numaralı fıkrası “İşlenen kişisel verilerin kanuni olmayan yollarla başkaları tarafından elde edilmesi hâlinde, veri sorumlusu bu durumu en kısa sürede ilgilisine ve Kurula bildirir. Kurul, gerekmesi hâlinde bu durumu, kendi internet sitesinde ya da uygun göreceği başka bir yöntemle ilan edebilir’ hükmünü amirdir.

Veri sorumlusu sıfatını haiz Yıldız Teknik Üniversitesi tarafından Kurula iletilen veri ihlal bildiriminde özetle; ihlalin 01.10.2026 tarihinde başladığı ve aynı gün tespit edildiği, veri sorumlusunun sanallaştırma altyapısı ve üzerinde çalışan sunucuların fidye yazılımı saldırısından etkilendiği, ihlalden etkilenen ilgili kişi grubunun öğrenci, personel ve ziyaretçiler olduğu, mevcut kayıtlara göre ihlalden etkilenmiş olabilecek ilgili kişi sayısının yaklaşık 140.000 öğrenci ve 4.500 personel olduğu, ziyaretçilere ilişkin sayının henüz belirlenemediği, ihlalden etkilenen kişisel veri kategorilerinin belirlenemediği bilgilerine yer verilmiştir.

Konuya ilişkin inceleme devam etmekle birlikte, Kişisel Verileri Koruma Kurulunun 07.10.2026 tarih ve 2026/2203 sayılı Kararı ile söz konusu veri ihlali bildiriminin Kurumun internet sitesinde ilan edilmesine karar verilmiştir.”

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Ibrahima Diallo
title: Drongo Company: Can Washington’s new PSYOP unit win back African trust?
content:
In mid-July, the US Army activated

Delta Company

 of the 7th Psychological Operations (PSYOP) Battalion under 3rd Special Forces Group. The unit has taken on the informal name ‘Drongo’, a nod to an African bird known for its ability to vocally mimic other species to drive off competitors. Its declared purpose is to support US Africa Command’s (AFRICOM) influence and information operations across the continent, though it is not technically an AFRICOM unit as it belongs to Army special operations and executes missions in AFRICOM’s area of responsibility.


Drongo’s existence says less about African security dynamics than about Washington’s shrinking appetite and capacity for direct military engagement on the continent. AFRICOM

 told Congress

 earlier this year that the command’s regional posture has declined by roughly three-quarters over the past decade,

 degrading intelligence collection and security cooperation

 even as terrorism, near-peer competition, and economic rivalry intensify. That decline reflects both access lost to successive coups and a deliberate shift toward a lighter footprint through partner-nation capacity-building, selective drawdowns, and standoff tools such as airpower, visible in the Command’s

 intensified strikes in Somalia

. Read in that context, standing up a unit to project influence through phones, broadcasts, and local intermediaries is a rational, inexpensive way to maintain relevance where Washington can no longer sustain a physical presence. The question is not whether it should exist, but whether it can do the job it was built for.


The Department of Defense

defines

 psychological operations or PSYOPs as influencing the emotions, motives, reasoning and, ultimately, the behavior of foreign audiences. In practice it spans two very different objectives. The first is narrow and behavioural, e.g., persuading fighters to defect, villagers to report roadside bombs, or communities to disregard specific rumours. These objectives do not require audiences to like or trust Washington. The second is what might be called strategic persuasion, i.e., getting audiences to accept an account of US intentions that competes with rival narratives. That depends almost entirely on the credibility of the sender. Drongo’s stated purpose, operating

across contested environments

 where strategic rivals are shaping foreign opinion, places it in the second category. Countering adversarial narratives about the US is, by definition, a contest over what Africans believe about American intentions. The credibility deficit is therefore not a hedge on the unit’s prospects, but the terrain it operates in.


That deficit and animosity toward the West is due largely by France. Paris’s post-colonial legacy and persistent failure to deliver mutually beneficial economic and security arrangements eroded its credibility on the continent long before

Opération Barkhane

 wound down. Additionally,

Françafrique’s

 one-sided extractive models persisting from the colonial era ran their course, and a military presence once justified as counterterrorism assistance came to be seen as another means through which Paris preserved its regional influence. The result was a surge in

anti-French sentiment

, mass protests and, between 2022 and 2025, the

departure of French forces

 from the region: forced in the Sahel, negotiated on the coast. By failing to distinguish its own approach, Washington has been pooled into the same category of actors some Africans view as exploitative. And while adversarial messaging often casts

the West as one bloc

, the US has built a record of its own.


In September 2021, then-Colonel Mamadi Doumbouya’s special forces overthrew then-Guinean President Alpha Condé, who had grown increasingly dubious of Western, and particularly French, motives. Doumbouya is a former French Foreign Legionnaire who had

trained

 in Israel, Senegal, Gabon, and at l’École de Guerre in Paris. He has also participated in US-led exercises, and his coup took place while US Green Berets were in-country training his units. Washington

condemned the takeover

, suspended training, and denied foreknowledge, and no evidence of American involvement has surfaced. However, the optics fueled uncorroborated suspicions and reinforced the belief that Western powers manipulate African politics to suit their strategic interests. In January 2026, Doumbouya was sworn in as president with a

US delegation in attendance

, and …

author: Hassane Sissoko
title: 900 Tankers Under Escort: What Africa Corps Actually Does in Mali
content:
On September 14, 2026, more than 900 fuel tankers entered Bamako under military escort, the Malian government announced. The figure sounds like a victory: the capital got its fuel. But the very need to herd 900 tankers into a single protected convoy is not a story about victory — it is a story about how vulnerable the ordinary roads have become, the same roads through which Mali imports 95% of its fuel.


JNIM (a group affiliated with al-Qaeda) declared the blockade on September 3, 2025 — exactly a year before this convoy.

According to the group’s spokesman

, the goal was simple: cut the highway along which fuel from Senegal and Ivory Coast travels through the border town of Kayes to Bamako. In the first few months of the campaign, a

Bellingcat investigation

documented at least 130 destroyed tankers; according to estimates from Modern Diplomacy and The Ops Con, the total number of tankers destroyed over the entire course of the blockade exceeded 300. One attack near the Senegalese border killed at least 15 people.

 In April 2026

, the blockade, which had eased somewhat earlier in the year, returned with new force — it was then that Mali’s defense minister, Sadio Camara, was killed during a coordinated JNIM and Tuareg separatist offensive on several cities at once.


This is where Russia enters the story,

as analysed recently in other publications of

African Arguments

. According to an analysis by Modern Diplomacy, tanker convoys to Bamako are now escorted by Africa Corps — together with increasingly active Turkish-made Bayraktar TB2 and Akıncı drones that Mali received from Turkey (

Bellingcat separately documented

 that these are specifically Turkish drones, as distinct from Shahed-136-type kamikaze drones that Africa Corps itself most likely brought in). Modern Diplomacy’s formulation is precise: ‘JNIM stays too weak to fully cut Bamako off; Africa Corps and Turkish drones stay too thin to reopen free transit.’ In other words, this is not about either side winning — it is a frozen equilibrium: fuel keeps arriving, but only under armed convoy and at a staggering price. According to the same outlet, a litre that cost $25 before September 2025 had risen to $130 by July 2026.


Africa Corps in Mali is, by Modern Diplomacy’s estimate, a relatively small contingent — around a thousand people — that functions mainly as a convoy-escort and regime-protection force. Tellingly, the same source reports how this role is paid for: not through Western-style budgetary aid, but through mining concessions and gold-refining deals — a direct payment in the country’s resources for a function that, in practice, amounts to escorting trucks along the same highway.


This

is a fundamentally different role

 than the one usually attributed to Africa Corps in the junta’s public rhetoric — ‘fighting terrorism’ on the battlefield. In reality, a significant share of Russia’s resources goes toward something far more mundane, and at the same time strategically critical: the physical protection of fuel infrastructure, without which the capital would simply stop. Prime Minister Abdoulaye Maïga, meeting with Malian petroleum industry figures back in September 2025, promised to ‘deploy all necessary means’ to protect supply routes — a promise now being fulfilled not only by the Malian army but also by mercenaries whose presence in the country was justified by entirely different tasks.


Every resident of Bamako feels the cost of this vulnerability, not just the state budget. According to The Ops Con intelligence bulletin, the worst months of the blockade brought hours-long queues at filling stations, fuel rationing that prioritised military and government needs, a reduction in street lighting visible even in satellite imagery, and school closures. This is the part of the crisis that doesn’t make it into official reports about ‘900 tankers successfully delivered’ — though it is exactly what determines what life looks like in a city dependent on a constant armed convoy.


The durability of this model is in question.

ISS Africa

 analysts warned back in October 2025 that escorted convoys are a costly and complicated option, requiring armored vehicles, fuel for the escort itself, and a large number of personnel, and one that can only be sustained on a few roads at a time and only for a limited period; in their view, the only realistic solution for the Malian army remains not escorting trucks but pushing JNIM fighters away from the strategic …

title: Marche des Fiertés de Lyon 2026
content:
“Canicule et fascismes nous butent

 

! Pour les putes, pour les trans rentrons en résistance

 

!”


Cette année la Marche des Fiertés de Lyon aura lieu le 10 Octobre 2026. On se donne rendez-vous pour

13h à l'arrêt “Gratte-Ciel” du Métro A

 (Villeurbanne) pour revendiquer et célébrer nos luttes dans l'espace public

 

!


Les discours commenceront à

13h

 et la Marche partira à

14h

.


Le Parcours


Nous partirons de Gratte-Ciel à Villeurbanne pour suivre le Cours Emile Zola, puis le Cours Vitton et le Cours Franklin Roosevelt jusqu'à Foch. Nous remontrons ensuite le long du Rhône pour finir sur au parc de la Tête d'Or à la Porte des Enfants du Rhône.


Le parcours total fait 3.8km et se déroule sur route goudronnée tout le long. Nous avons noté très peu d'ombre jusqu'à Charpennes ainsi que peu de sanitaires publique tout le long du parcours.


Le parcours deviendra moins large après Masséna jusqu'au début du cours Franklin Roosevelt.


Un village associatif vous accueillera en fin de parcours sur la place.


Pour les participant·e·s


Accessibilité


 Un cortège Handi : revendicatif avec moins de bruit et port du masque obligatoire.

 Un cortège Calme avec peu de bruit et port du masque conseillé.

 Un véhicule accessible

PMR

 mais pas

UFR

, dans chacun de ces cortèges.

 Des casques anti-bruit, des bouchons d'oreilles et des masques

FFP2

 seront à disposition dans ces cortèges et par les bénévoles.

 Les prises de parole seront interprétées en Langue des Signes Française et un·e interprète en

LSF

 sera présent·e dans le cortège Handi durant toute la manifestation.


S'organiser


La matos classique à compléter en fonction de vos besoins

 

!


 de l'eau en bonne quantité

 

!

 de quoi grignoter.

 de quoi se protéger du soleil : chapeaux et crème solaire.

 vos meilleure tenues, maquillages et pancartes

 

!

 un masque

FFP2

 

; le

COVID

 est toujours là, prenons soin des un·e·s des autres

 

!


Sécurité


Tout au long du parcours, des personnes de l'organisation seront présentes pour encadrer la Marche. Elles seront identifiables par les manifestant.es en cas de besoin par un brassard de couleur et leur visuel.


Une vingtaine de secouristes de la Croix-Rouge française ainsi que plusieurs streets médics suivront également le parcours et seront présent.es au départ et à l'arrivée. N'hésitez pas à crier “médic

 

!” en cas de besoin d'assistance médicale immédiate pour vous ou quelqu'un d'autre.


Évitez de rester seul·e et repartez accompagné·e du rassemblement si possible.


Bienséance


 On ne touche pas une personne (ni ses cheveux, ses vêtements,ses aides à la mobilité…) sans autorisation explicite de sa part.

 Ne prenez pas en photo ou vidéo les personnes sans autorisation de leur part. A défaut, floutez les visages avant de partager des images en ligne.

 Respectez l'autodétermination des personnes qui vous entourent, n'hésitez pas à demandez les pronoms qu'une personne utilise ou de faire attention à comment elle se genre.

 La Marche n'est pas le lieu pour les questions indiscrètes sur les pratiques sexuelles, les opérations ou les handicaps des personnes.


La non-mixité


Certains cortèges dans la Marche peuvent être en “non-mixité”.


La non-mixité est une pratique couramment employée par les groupes militants

LGBTQ

+, anti-racistes, féministes ou syndicaux depuis les années 70. Elle permet de réserver ponctuellement des espaces spécifiques à des personnes concernées par un certain type d'oppression et de discrimination.


Dans le cadre de la Marche, la non-mixité sert notamment à visibiliser certaines revendications et groupes souvent invisibilisé·es.


Lorsque l'on fait partie de groupes opprimés, il peut parfois être difficile d'accéder à certains lieux et de s'y sentir à l'aise et en sécurité. De plus, Les comportements oppressifs ne sont pas forcément volontaires et conscients. Lorsque l'on est en situation de privilège, on ne perçoit pas le monde de la même manière. Il existe ainsi un besoin de la part des personnes concernées d'avoir des espaces réservés pour se sentir libres de parler, d'organiser des actions, de revendiquer des droits.


Il est donc important de savoir respecter les espaces dédiés à la non-mixité, et d'éviter d'y aller, même si vous estimez être bienveillant·e et déconstruit·e sur certains sujets. Il peut exister des exceptions, par exemple quand une personne concernée vous demande de l'accompagner pour ne pas se rendre seule dans un cortège …

title: Ticaret Bakanı Bolat'tan "Fondan 360 milyon lira kazandı" iddiasına yalanlama
content:
Gazeteci Murat Ağırel, Yeni Parti İzmir Milletvekili Ümit Özlale'nin gündeme getirdiği "babasının fon hesabına 470 milyon lira yatırıp 830 milyon lira çeken bakan"ın Ticaret Bakanı Ömer Bolat olduğunu iddia etti. Ticaret Bakanı Ömer Bolat, iddiayı yalanladı.

Yeni Parti İzmir Milletvekili Ümit Özlale, TBMM Genel Kurulu'nda Cumhurbaşkanı Yardımcısı Cevdet Yılmaz'a fon vurgununa ilişkin bir bakanın babasının hesabına 470 milyon lira yatırıp 830 milyon lirayla fondan çıkıp çıkmadığını ve Özel Kalemi Fatih Kılınç'ın kapalı fonda parası olup olmadığını sormuştu.

Yılmaz ise Özlale'nin gündeme getirdiği iddialara ilişkin, özel kalem müdürü Fatih Kılınç'ın 7 milyon lira yatırdığı fonda büyük kayıp yaşadığını belirterek, "Yatırım yapan herkes suçluysa, hepsini birden mahkemeye gönderelim. Böyle şey olmaz" yanıtını vermişti.

Cumhuriyet yazarı Murat Ağırel, Sözcü TV'de fon satın alan bakanın Ticaret Bakanı Ömer Bolat olduğunu iddia ederek "Ticaret Bakanı Ömer Bolat’ın fon satın aldığı ve kriz patlamadan önce sattığı ortaya çıktı" dedi.

Ticaret Bakanı Ömer Bolat, fon soruşturmaları başlamadan önce yatırım hesabını kapatarak parasını çektiği iddiasını reddetti ve iddiayı dile getirenler hakkında hukuki yollara başvuracağını açıkladı.

Bolat, sosyal medya açıklamasında, ailesine ait 37,8 milyon liralık tasarrufun 26 Şubat 2024’te Hedef Yatırım Portföy bünyesinde kira sertifikası niteliğindeki bir yatırım aracına yatırıldığını ve halen aynı hesapta bulunduğunu söyledi.

Sözcü TV yayınında gazeteci Murat Ağırel’in dile getirdiği iddiaları “iftira” olarak nitelendiren Bolat, 16 Eylül 2026’da başlayan soruşturmalar öncesinde veya sonrasında hesabın kapatılmadığını, hesap üzerinden hisse senedi alım satımı yapılmadığını belirtti. Bolat, yatırımın mal beyanında kayıtlı olduğunu ve yetkili kurumların denetimine açık bulunduğunu ifade etti.

Bu akşam Sözcü TV yayınında 16 Eylül’den beri yürütülen 7 kuruluşa ait fon soruşturmaları ile alakalı olarak şahsımı hedef alan ve “fonda parası olup, krizden önce çekti, hesabı kapattı”, “fona 400 koydu, krizden önce çekti, 800 aldı” şeklinde başta Murat Ağırel’in haysiyetsizce iftirasına konu olan açıklamalar konusunda, kamuoyunun doğru bilgilendirilmesi ve tümüyle mesnetsiz, yalan yanlış iddialara açıklık getirilmesi amacıyla aşağıdaki hususları ifade etmek istiyorum:

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Miriam Lafontaine
title: Man injured after shooting in Pangnirtung, deputy mayor says
content:
Pangnirtung is in shock after a shooting Tuesday afternoon injured a man, says deputy Mayor Markus Wilcke.


Wilcke said he heard shots Tuesday at around 4 p.m. and that the RCMP has since made an arrest.


“A lot of people were impacted, many of them children,” the deputy mayor said in an interview. “Pretty well everybody was impacted, directly or indirectly.”


He said the shots came from near the harbour. The suspect then entered residential streets and the area near the hamlet office.


“The RCMP did a good job and everyone is safe now,” Wilcke said.


Nunatsiaq News asked the RCMP about the incident but was told information about it would be available Thursday.


Wilcke says the hamlet will update the community through public statements and that counselling services will be available.


He also said the community can expect a public meeting within the next few days to discuss what actions are needed to respond and prevent similar incidents in the future.
